jobs.title: Southern California Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**National Forest Foundation (NFF)** is pleased to offer an exempt, full\-time, 2\-Year term position that will support the Southern California Ignition Reduction Program (SCIRP), a public\-private partnership of governmental agencies and their partners working together to reduce human\-caused ignitions, primarily along roadsides.

**About the NFF:** As the official national partner to the US Forest Service (USFS), the National Forest Foundation was chartered by Congress in 1990\. Today, the NFF advances forest resiliency, healthy watersheds and wildlife habitat, and recreation for all by working with communities and organizations across the country. The Foundation has grown significantly in the last few years in programmatic impact, revenue and support, and organizational capacity. NFF leads with impact, deploying roughly 90% of its expenses towards projects and programs across the country’s 193\-million\-acre National Forest System. NFF is forward\-thinking and innovative, with ambitious strategies and goals to advance and prepare forests for a new economy.

**Position Function:** The Southern California Project Coordinator reports to the Southern California Program Director and will work closely with key members of SCIRP, including the USDA Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.


The Project Coordinator will support project development and implementation of roadside ignition projects; coordinate with federal, state, and private partners; and support fundraising efforts for projects. This position will work with their supervisor and key members of SCIRP to support project solicitation, project prioritization, and development of the 10\-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.


**Position Duties and Responsibilities:** The Southern California Project Coordinator will:

* Work closely with the key SCIRP members and teams to develop project pipeline tools that will support project prioritization, planning, and implementation.
* Support development of the 10\-Year Project Portfolio and Master Plan.
* Develop relationships and facilitate communication between SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Develop agendas, facilitate, and document takeaways for meetings among SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Coordinate with agency partners to complete environmental review, including coordinating associated activities and processes as needed.
* Coordinate and oversee site visits with SCIRP partners and project leads.
* Provide regular updates to the SCIRP Executive Committee and Core Team.
* Work with NFF staff and SCIRP members to secure funds from government sources, foundations, corporations, and individuals to support projects.
* Support preparation of progress and funding reports for federal, state, and local government funding sources as well as for philanthropic support from corporations, foundations, and individuals.
* Oversee the advertisement, negotiation, and award of contracts for services related to SCIRP projects.
* Maintain a breadth of knowledge about current trends, emerging issues, policy interventions, and innovations related to wildfire risk reduction and relevant land management policy and regulations.

**Education and Qualifications:** NFF expects the Southern California Project Coordinator to possess the following educational and experiential qualifications:

* Minimum of an undergraduate degree in natural resource management, biological sciences, environmental policy, or another related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum of three (3\) years’ experience in project management, government agency relations, or natural resource management.
* Familiarity with the US Forest Service, California Department of Conservation, California Department of Transportation, and California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection.
* Knowledge of Southern California and Central Coast natural resource management and policy principles, practices, and concepts sufficient to perform the full range of activities connected with planning and coordinating natural resources projects.
* Knowledge of and experience in U.S. Forest Service and/or State of California land management policies, procedures, and regulations.
* Experience working effectively in collaborative efforts with individuals or groups that have a multitude of views.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

**Abilities and Skills:** NFF expects the Southern California Project Coordinator to possess the following proven abilities and skills:

* Ability to work collaboratively to manage projects with multiple partners, including advanced communication skills and coordination and facilitation skills.
* Ability to represent the NFF in a clear and professional manner through excellent written and oral communication skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
* Ability to effectively set priorities, manage timelines, and create workflows, while managing a variety of projects and tasks to successful completion.
* Ability to utilize a variety of document and data management platforms.
* Ability to work well and be flexible in a team\-oriented environment.
* Self\-driven and motivated to stay focused and productive in a fully remote work environment
* Must have valid U.S. driver’s license and clean driving record.
* Ability and willingness to travel when required to project sites in Southern California and Central Coast, as needed.
* Excellent analytical skills with a strong attention to detail.

**Location:** The location for this position is Southern California in a community near the Los Padres, Angeles, San Bernardino, or Cleveland National Forests. Applicants must be able to travel regularly throughout the Central Coast and Southern California. This position is a remote/work\-from\-home position and requires reliable internet access and a dedicated workspace.

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Rimkus and unlock your potential with endless opportunities for growth, learning, and making a difference!


Rimkus (www.rimkus.com) is a worldwide leader in Engineering and Technical Consulting. Rimkus experts specialize in building envelope, engineering, forensic consulting, dispute resolution, construction management services, and solutions built for the environment.


NOW IS THE TIME to join this growing and stable company! We offer our full\-time employees a competitive salary, bonus opportunities and a full benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, disability, employer\-matching 401(k), and opportunities for advancement!


We are currently seeking Project Coordinator that will assist designated Project Managers with day\-to\-day project and coordinating functions. The primary job duties consist of providing a high level of support to our clients in support of the professional’s forensic engineering work. This is an in\-office position where the individual is expected to be onsite during business hours.

 **Requirements** **Essential Job Functions**

* Provides project support and coordination work.
* Manages email and calendar.
* Assists with scheduling of meetings, conference calls, inspections, and deposition or trial testimony.
* Assists with logging time and expenses.
* Tracks project milestones and deliverables to ensure timely completion.
* Organizes and manages electronic project records.
* Coordinates electronic file sharing of project data.
* Coordinates shipping of technical equipment between district offices and Project Managers.
* Coordinates technical equipment needs and team resources.
* Other miscellaneous duties as assigned.

**Required Education and Certifications**

* An associate’s or bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills are required.
* Outstanding computer skills are expected, including the ability to effectively use and assist others with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience with shared Outlook Calendar as a scheduling tool is a plus.
* Experience in a project support or coordination role in the engineering, legal, or insurance fields a plus.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated poise, tact, and diplomacy.
* Must be able to handle sensitive and confidential information.
* Must have good organizational skills as well as analytical and interpretive skills.
* Should have the ability to manage multiple projects and set priorities.
* Must have the ability to work independently or in a team environment.
* Must have dependable transportation and have a valid Driver’s license.

**Physical Demands, Overtime, and Travel Requirements**


Work is performed primarily in an office setting. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, bend, crouch, hear, and talk (must be able to speak and communicate clearly with employees). Employee may lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Clear vision and depth perception are also necessary.


There will be periods where overtime will be required to meet the company’s business needs.

*Rimkus is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and will make all employment\-related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.*

 **Benefits**  

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability
* Training \& Development
* Work From Home

jobs.title: Youth Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k)
* Company parties
* Competitive salary
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
**Job Purpose/Summary**  


The Youth Program Specialist provides culturally responsive, strengths\-based support services to American Indian, Alaska Native, and Indigenous youth. This position promotes positive youth development, cultural identity, resilience, educational success, behavioral health, and overall well\-being through mentoring, advocacy and community engagement.  


The Youth Program Specialist is responsible for recruiting and engaging American Indian, Alaska Native and Indigenous youth to participate in youth services at Sacred Path Indigenous Wellness Center. They will receive instruction on the Motivational Interviewing and Culture for Native American Youth (MICUNAY) curriculum and facilitate workshops (both virtual and in person) with this curriculum for youth ages 12\-17 and 18\-26\. The Youth Program Specialist will also provide mentoring and peer support.  


The Youth Program Specialist works collaboratively with youth, families, Tribal communities, elders, schools, behavioral health providers, and community partners to support youth in achieving their goals while honoring Indigenous values, traditions, and cultural practices. The position is expected to uphold principles of cultural humility, trauma\-informed care, and community\-centered service delivery.

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Youth Engagement and Support**  

* Establish trusting, supportive relationships with American Indian, Alaska Native, and Indigenous youth.
* Develop workshop content, agendas, and learning materials to align with the desired outcomes and target audience. Place orders for materials (and food, if applicable) and secure a site, if necessary.
* Lead workshops by engaging participants through various interactive methods, encouraging discussions, and managing group dynamics. Ensure that workshops follow required procedures (e.g., sign\-in sheets, surveys).
* Clearly communicate workshop objectives, expectations, and guidelines to participants, ensuring a shared understanding.
* Provide individual/group mentoring and peer support.
* Assist youth in identifying personal, educational, career, cultural, and wellness goals.
* Promote leadership development, self\-advocacy, and life skills.
* Encourage healthy social, emotional, spiritual, and cultural development.
* Support youth participation in cultural, traditional, and community activities.

**Cultural and Community\-Based Services**  

* Incorporate Indigenous values, traditions, and cultural practices into service delivery.
* Strengthen cultural identity, community connections and sense of belonging.
* Collaborate with elders, cultural practitioners, Tribal representatives, and community leaders to support programming.
* Assist with planning and facilitating cultural events, workshops, and youth activities.
* Promote respect for cultural diversity and community traditions.

**Documentation and Program Compliance**  

* Assist with data collection and reporting requirements for grants and contracts.
* Track program outcomes and performance measures.
* Collect participant feedback, evaluate workshop effectiveness, and make improvements.
* Ensure confidentiality and compliance with policies and applicable regulations.
* Keep supervisor(s) informed of any concerns or challenges.


  

**Collaboration and Community Outreach**  

* Work with Youth Services Program Coordinators to maximize outreach via social media accounts by creating content, posting and interacting with community regularly.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with schools, Tribal organizations, and community partners.
* Work with subcontractors to support in facilitating workshops; assist in ordering materials; ensure workshop procedures are followed; attend workshops to assist as needed.
* Conduct outreach and recruitment activities within Indigenous communities.

Represent Sacred Path at community meetings, events, and cultural gatherings, as needed.  
* 

**Other**  

Perform additional duties, as needed, in support of Sacred Path’s mission.  


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Must be between 18 and 26 years of age (funding source requirement)
* Strong interpersonal, communication and relationship\-building skills, capable of creating a positive and inclusive learning environment.
* Flexibility to adapt to different learning styles, participant backgrounds, and unexpected challenges.
* Effective organizational and time\-management skills.
* Knowledge of positive youth development and trauma\-informed care principles.
* Understanding of the historical and contemporary experiences impacting American Indian, Alaska Native, and Indigenous communities.


Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Program Operations Coordinator 1
jobs.description:
**SPECIAL SERVICE FOR GROUPS, INC.**
Job Description  

 Title: Program Operations Coordinator 1 Division: HOPICS  

 FLSA: Non\-Exempt, Full\-time Supervisor: Business Operations Manager  

 Pay Scale: $25\.00\-30\.00  

  

**Summary**  

Under the supervision of the Business Operations Manager, the Program Operations Coordinator I is primarily responsible for supporting the agency's Accounts Payable function by reviewing, verifying, processing, and maintaining financial transactions in compliance with agency policies, funding requirements, and internal controls. The position also provides administrative and operational support to the Business Operations Department as assigned. The Program Operations Coordinator I supports the day\-to\-day functions of the Accounts Payable department by maintaining financial records, monitoring invoice processing, communicating with vendors and internal staff, researching payment discrepancies, and assisting with month\-end and fiscal year\-end activities. In addition to Accounts Payable responsibilities, the position provides operational support for administrative processes, financial record keeping, and other Business Operations functions as assigned. The role  

requires strong attention to detail, sound organizational skills, discretion when handling confidential financial information, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.  

  

**Essential Functions**  

Accounts Payable Operations  

 Prepare and maintain accurate financial logs, reconciliation reports, receipts, and supporting documentation.  

 Prepare invoices and supporting documentation for payment processing in accordance with agency policies and procedures.  

 Verify invoice accuracy, coding, approvals, and supporting documentation prior to submission for payment processing.  

 Maintain organized filing systems for operational, financial, and administrative records.  

 Ensure compliance with agency policies, audit standards, and financial procedures.  

 Receive, review, and process vendor invoices.  

 Process Request for Check (RFC) packets.  

 Enter invoices into QuickBooks.  

 Reconcile vendor statements and research discrepancies.  

 Respond to vendor payment inquiries.  

 Maintain AP records and documentation.  

 Track invoice aging and payment deadlines.  

 Assist with month\-end and fiscal year\-end AP activities.  

 Maintain confidentiality of financial records.  

 Scan, index, and electronically file Accounts Payable documentation in accordance with agency record retention requirements.  

 Maintain vendor records and assist with vendor onboarding and documentation as assigned.  

  

Business Operations Support  

 Assist with day\-to\-day administrative and operational activities across assigned HOPICS locations.  

 Maintain and monitor petty cash funds, travel advances, and company\-issued gift cards in accordance with agency financial policies and internal controls.  

 Track distribution, usage, reconciliation, and documentation of cash funds and gift cards.  

 Prepare spreadsheets, reports, tracking logs, and operational summaries as requested.  

 Respond to operational and administrative inquiries in a professional and timely manner.  

 Monitor operational expenditures and assist with tracking department spending and budget\-related documentation.  

 Coordinate ordering, tracking, and receipt of office, operational, and facility\-related supplies.  

Compliance \& Record keeping  

 Maintain confidentiality of financial, employee, participant, and operational information.  

 Support compliance with agency operational procedures and internal controls.  

 Maintain accurate records related to reservations, purchases, inventory, reconciliations, and operational activities.  

 Assist with audit preparation and documentation requests as needed.  

  

Communication \& Collaboration  

 Establish and maintain professional working relationships with staff, vendors, and community partners.  

 Communicate effectively regarding operational schedules, reservations, purchasing, and administrative processes.  

 Attend required meetings, training, and agency events.  

 Perform additional duties as assigned.  

  

**Secondary Functions**  

 Overtime, evening, or weekend work may occasionally be required based on operational or event needs.  

 Travel between HOPICS locations may be required.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications \- Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required**  

 High School Diploma or GED required; Associate degree preferred.  

 Minimum one (1\) year of experience in Accounts Payable, financial administrative support, accounting support, or  

bookkeeping, preferred.  

 Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate financial and operational records.  

 Ability to organize tasks, prioritize workload, and manage multiple assignments.  

 Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.  

 Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and database systems.  

 Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.  

 Valid California driver’s license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation may be required.  

 Successful completion of background screening and verification of employment eligibility required.  

  

**Non\-Essential Qualifications \- Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**  

 Experience working in nonprofit, social services, or multi\-site operational environments.  

 Experience with financial tracking systems, reservation systems, or accounts payable processes.  

 Bilingual skills preferred.  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities.  

  

**Environmental Conditions (Working Conditions)**  

The Program Operations Coordinator I works primarily in office and program site environments with frequent interaction with staff, vendors

jobs.title: Program Coordinator -11-205 - SC/ Zahn
jobs.description:
Mission Statement



The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian church. Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God. Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.



Position Summary



The Emergency Housing Manager is responsible for all operational aspects of The Salvation Army Zahn Emergency Shelter including management and regulatory compliance. Functional responsibilities include personnel selection and development, continuous quality improvement, fiscal management and community relations with Homeless agencies providers. (S)He represents The Salvation Army, through Zahn, to community\-based organizations, state agencies, health care organizations and private individuals involved in the homeless service provision.



Essential Functions


* Ensure that residents receive the care and supervision outlined in the resident’s Individual Care Plan/Individualized Housing Stability Plan.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
* Maintain positive communication and relationship with Department of Mental Health (DMH), Los Angeles Homeless Authority (LAHSA), Department of Social Service (DPSS), Family Solution Center (FSC) and other Homeless agencies.
* HMIS/Clarity Data.
* Promote the availability of the facility to agencies and organizations.
* Monitor and implement the applicable policies of Zahn Shelter.
* Complete and submit monthly DPSS report.
* Submit monthly and weekly Statistics.
* Submit annually evaluations of supervise staff.
* Ensure Zahn is up to code with the Health Department and Fire Department.
* Audit residential files periodically for quality assurance.
* Monitor staffs’ timesheets.
* Supervise and coordinate ongoing training for all staff at Zahn Emergency Shelter.
* Enforce resident and staff conduct, building and safety codes.
* Complete periodic reports as required by The Salvation Army, LAHSA and HMIS/Clarity.
* Attend weekly or monthly leadership meeting.
* Supervise all staff (desk clerks, cooks and maintenance) and appropriate outside agencies.
* Attend outside partnership agency meetings/network.
* Responsible for placing Shelter Partnership order and assuring clients have access to donations.
* Facilitate and lead the annually Cluster meeting regarding Zahn Emergency Shelter.


Working Conditions



Ability to walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis. Ability to grasp, push, pull objects. Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.



Minimum Qualifications


* A. degree or equivalent experience.
* Must be able to speak, read and write English; bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.
* Must pass criminal background check.
* Knowledge of basic hotel\-type operations, housing regulations and Cal/OSHA requirements for safe housing environment.
* Red Cross First Aid and CPR certification.


Skills, Knowledge, \& Abilities


* Must be culturally sensitive and non\-judgmental
* Knowledge and sensitivity regarding issues of homelessness, mental illness, substance abuse, HIV/AIDS, etc.
* Ability to supervise staff to effectively manage multiple projects in a high\-performance environment.
* Supervisory experience.
* Knowledge of Universal precautions.
* CPR/First Aid Certification.

jobs.description:
**Summary**

The Sales Coordinator is responsible for supporting the marketing and selling of the California Science Center Foundation’s (“Foundation”) third party (external) events and assisting with internal and external event management as needed. Provides daily support with client sales communication, site tour scheduling, and calendar management. Confirms bookings by drafting and distributing Event Reservation Agreement and billing and collecting deposits. Supports event marketing and social media initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* BA Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or related field.
* 2\+ years of professional marketing or sales experience in a related field.
* Experience managing promotional campaigns, client outreach, advertising and social media preferred, but not required.
* Specialty venue, hotel, hospitality industry, catering or Convention \& Visitor Bureau experience to promote and sell our destination preferred, but not required.
* Proficient knowledge of event planning and management.
* Experience executing contracts preferred, but not required.
* Superb organizational skills with great attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal and verbal/written communications skills.
* Must be a task\-oriented self\-starter with a high level of motivation.
* Available to occasionally support events outside of standard work shift, including evenings and weekends, with advance notice.
* Computer skills: Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook based calendar, Social Tables (Diagram software – preferred, but not required).

**Skills**

* Vets and responds to potential clients in a timely and professional manner and provides accurate information to help convert inquiries to contracts when appropriate.
* Becomes an expert on the Foundation’s facility and event capabilities.
* Schedules and facilitates event sales walkthroughs with potential clients.
* Supports contracting with clients by drafting Event Reservation Agreements for third party events. Once approved for distribution, confirms events by circulating ERAs and collecting deposits.
* Maintains events department calendar, client and vendor databases.
* Creates promotional materials (electronic and printed) to distribute to potential clients.
* Updates internal and remote websites and marketing deck to feature new exhibits and event venues.
* Contributes to Social Media campaign to help drive event sales.
* Identifies and implements new advertising and marketing opportunities, both complimentary and paid.
* Apprises events team of potential and new business at regular intervals.
* Attends industry related events and networks through various functions to identify new event clients, when required.
* Processes and records catering commission payments.
* Processes internal and external invoices utilizing the Science Center’s accounting software (Intranet System \& Financial Edge).
* Completes and submits event\-related forms.
* Completes department board reports and credit card reports.
* Purchases office supplies, office equipment, etc. for the department in accordance with the company purchasing policies and budgetary restrictions.
* Assists with third party and internal events as needed.
* Assists VP with special projects.
* Performs other duties as required.

Pay: $26\.50 \- $29\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Honor Technology's mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor's growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world's leading provider of in\-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.



Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.



Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

**About the Role:**



As an **Operations Coordinator**, you play a critical frontline role ensuring that care delivery remains seamless, responsive, and compassionate — even under pressure. You'll handle real\-time staffing coordination, same\-day scheduling changes, and urgent communication between clients, families, and Care Pros.


**This is a remote role. Depending on your preference the schedules available are below.**


* Four Days: Friday \- Monday 11:30am \- 10:00pm Central Time
* Five Days: Sunday \- Thursday 6:00am \-2:30pm Central Time


**Please note: Attendance during training (two weeks, full\-time, Monday \- Friday 9:00am to 5pm Central Time) is required; this includes being on camera and actively engaged throughout all sessions.**

  


**Why you'll love this role:**



You'll be joining a purpose\-driven team that blends empathy with operational excellence — keeping clients safe, Care Pros supported, and the system running smoothly. You'll gain exposure to national\-scale care delivery logistics, advance your operational skill set, and contribute directly to the mission of transforming aging. With opportunities to grow into more senior roles focused on Client Management, Care Pro Relationship Management, Care Pro Recruiting, and Care Pro HR.

  


**As an Operations Coordinator at Honor, you provide:**


* **Same\-Day Staffing \& Coordination:** Ensure timely and accurate caregiver scheduling to meet client needs and preferences, especially during same\-day changes or emergencies.
* **Real\-Time Communication \& Support:** Serve as the first point of contact for urgent client and family needs. Respond promptly to time\-sensitive situations, providing clear updates and empathetic support.
* **Task Execution:** Execute operational tasks including check\-ins, staffing activities, and managing inbound communications in alignment with established workflows and policies.
* **Issue Resolution:** Address service delivery challenges with urgency and professionalism, ensuring the best experience for clients and Care Pros.
* **Documentation \& Compliance:** Accurately record client updates, staffing changes, and escalations, maintaining regulatory and company documentation standards.
* **Communication \& Escalation Management:** Deliver critical updates to owners, clients, families, and Care Pros—tailoring messages by audience, tone, and communication preferences to ensure clarity and understanding.

  


**We're looking for you to bring:**


* 3\+ years of experience in **customer service or operations** in a **healthcare, staffing, or call center** environment
* Hands\-on experience handling **real\-time scheduling, dispatch, or triage**
* Demonstrated **tech fluency**, with comfort navigating multiple platforms (CRM, EMR, or workforce management tools)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; skilled in de\-escalation and empathy
* Reliable attendance and commitment to full participation in training and ongoing shifts
* Consistent tenure and accountability in previous roles — you take ownership and follow through

  


**Key Performance Indicators for this role:**


* Phone Answer Rate
* Task Acceptance Rate
* Time Available for Tasks
* Time Available for Calls

  

**Leadership Principles in Action as Operations Coordinator:**



Honor's Leadership Principles are the foundation of translating our mission into action. These principles define how we show up and make decisions, and how we hire, develop and grow talent. While Honor has 13 leadership principles, the following are particularly relevant to this role:


* **Are Mission First:** Leaders demonstrate a genuine passion for our mission. They prioritize decisions and activities that move the mission forward.
* **Relentlessly Focus on Clients:** Leaders always start with the client and work backwards. They are maniacally focused on creating solutions that lead to better care for our clients.
* **Always Push:** Leaders set a high bar for themselves and others. They know that mediocrity isn't an option; they set ambitious goals, always strive for better, and commit to delivering top\-notch service and outcomes.

  



\#LI\-AN1


At Honor, we put people first. Our leadership culture is guided by Leadership Principles that prioritize integrity, compassion, and excellence. We offer a unique opportunity to lead with purpose and make a meaningful impact no matter your role.



Honor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or belief.

jobs.title: Sales and Marketing Assistant
jobs.description:
Pac\-Dent Inc. headquartered in Brea, CA, is a fast\-growing international design, manufacturing and wholesale dental product and device company. Founded in 1992, Pac\-Dent has earned its reputation as one of the best and most reliable in the dental industry. Pac\-Dent serves its customers through state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing, strong research and development capabilities, innovative approach to lean operations, and superior customer service by constantly adapting to market and customer needs. With its mission of Passion for Excellence, Pac\-Dent focuses on delivering the highest quality, technologically advanced and innovative products in the preventive, restorative, teeth whitening, endodontic, and infection control segments.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Sales and Marketing Associate is responsible for communicating with customers; scheduling meetings; collecting customer information; entering data required for sales quotes, deliveries and invoices, and promptly responding to customer inquiries, among other project\-based work. May also train and supervise lower\-level clerical staff.

The Sales and Marketing Associate reports to the Director of Sales \& Marketing.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

The ideal candidate will be experienced in a wide range of administrative and sales\-related tasks and will work independently with little or no supervision. This person must be exceedingly well organized, flexible, and enjoy the challenges of a sales role with administrative tasks. The ability to interact with staff (at all levels) in a fast\-paced environment, sometimes under pressure, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient with a high level of professionalism and confidentiality is crucial to this role.

· Must possess a 2\-year Associate's (4\-year Bachelor's degree preferred) from a nationally accredited US institution

· Assist in identifying, developing, and managing relationships with new customers, as well as nurturing relationships with current customers

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to speak with potential and existing customers via phone, email, trade shows, or other events

· Assist in the implementation of company marketing plans as needed

· Willingness to learn and be adaptable to varying situations and requirements

· Attention to detail is a must

· Must be exceedingly well\-organized

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite

Experience

Demonstrated experience working with minimal supervision or direction. Experience as a Sales Assistant/Coordinator and prior knowledge of the workings of a manufacturing company is a plus. Prior experience with an ERP system is a significant plus.

Local candidates only, remote work not offered. Recent grads are welcome.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Clinical Research Coordinator

**Location:** Lakewood/Long Beach California  
**Position Type:** Full\-Time, Onsite

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC)** to join our clinical research team in **Lakewood, California**. Our research sites conduct clinical trials across a range of therapeutic areas, with a strong focus on **metabolic disease, obesity, diabetes, fatty liver disease, and related conditions**.

The Clinical Research Coordinator will work closely with Principal Investigators, Sub\-Investigators, sponsors, CROs, and the clinical operations team to ensure the successful execution of clinical research protocols. This is a hands\-on, patient\-facing position requiring strong clinical skills, attention to detail, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple study activities in a fast\-paced environment.

The ideal candidate is passionate about clinical research and patient care, is comfortable interacting with study participants, and can independently perform clinical procedures while maintaining strict adherence to study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

* Coordinate the day\-to\-day activities of assigned clinical research studies from start\-up through study closeout.
* Screen and recruit potential study participants according to protocol\-specific inclusion and exclusion criteria.
* Conduct informed consent discussions and ensure appropriate documentation of the consent process, as delegated and permitted by the protocol and site procedures.
* Schedule and conduct study visits and ensure all protocol\-required procedures are completed accurately and within required visit windows.
* Perform **phlebotomy and other clinical procedures** as required by study protocols.
* Process, prepare, label, and ship biological specimens in accordance with protocol, laboratory, and sponsor requirements.
* Obtain and document vital signs, ECGs, medical histories, medication histories, and other clinical assessments as required.
* Administer investigational products or other study\-related medications when appropriately delegated and trained.
* Assess and document adverse events, concomitant medications, and changes in participants' medical status.
* Review laboratory results and other study data and appropriately communicate clinically significant findings to the Investigator or designated medical staff.
* Maintain accurate and timely source documentation, electronic data capture (EDC) entries, and other required study documentation.
* Respond to data queries and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Maintain study\-specific regulatory and essential documents in accordance with ICH\-GCP, FDA requirements, and site SOPs.
* Communicate effectively with sponsors, CROs, monitors, vendors, investigators, and other members of the research team.
* Assist with sponsor monitoring visits, audits, inspections, and other study\-related activities.
* Track recruitment, screening, enrollment, retention, and study milestones.
* Educate participants regarding study procedures, visit requirements, medication administration, and study expectations.
* Maintain participant confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.
* Ensure all study activities are performed in accordance with the protocol, GCP, SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with the clinical team to provide a positive, professional, and patient\-centered research experience.

Required Qualifications

* **Current Phlebotomy Certification \- REQUIRED.**
* Minimum of **1 year of clinical research experience** preferred; experience as a Clinical Research Coordinator strongly preferred.
* Clinical healthcare experience involving direct patient care.
* Demonstrated proficiency in **venipuncture/phlebotomy** and specimen collection.
* Knowledge of ICH\-GCP, FDA regulations, and clinical research principles.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document clinical and research information.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple studies and competing priorities.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with investigators and the broader research team.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, patient\-facing clinical environment.
* Proficiency with electronic medical records and/or electronic clinical research systems.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and handle sensitive health information appropriately.
* **Bachelor's degree in nursing, life sciences, health sciences, or a related field**
* Equivalent clinical research or healthcare experience may be considered.

Preferred Experience

* Previous experience coordinating clinical trials from screening through study completion.
* Experience in **obesity, diabetes, metabolic disease, gastroenterology, hepatology, or fatty liver disease**.
* Experience with Phase I, II, III, or IV clinical trials.
* Experience with EDC systems such as Medidata Rave, Oracle Clinical, Veeva, or similar platforms.
* Experience with electronic medical records such as Epic, Athenahealth, or similar systems.
* Experience with ECGs, vital signs, specimen processing, and other protocol\-specific clinical assessments.
* Experience working with central laboratories and clinical trial specimen shipments.
* Previous experience communicating with sponsors, CROs, and clinical research monitors.
* Familiarity with clinical research terminology, essential documents, source documentation, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with patient recruitment, prescreening, and retention strategies.

jobs.title: Showroom & E-Commerce Coordinator
jobs.description:
Company: Sara Weinstock

Position: Showroom \& E\-Commerce Coordinator

Schedule: Full\-Time

Location: Los Angeles, CA

Classification: Non\-Exempt

Reports To: Primary – Office Manager; Secondary – Wholesale Account Manager

Position Overview

Sara Weinstock is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented, and dependable Showroom \& E\-Commerce Coordinator to support the day\-to\-day operations of our fine jewelry office, with a focus on showroom upkeep, inventory accuracy, e\-commerce, and general office support.

This is a hands\-on position that blends showroom maintenance and presentation, inventory coordination and tracking, e\-commerce and digital merchandising support, and the product organization, shipping/receiving, documentation, and administrative work of a fine jewelry office. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, comfortable handling high\-value merchandise, and able to follow established processes carefully from beginning to end.

Key Responsibilities

Showroom Maintenance \& Presentation

* Maintain the showroom in a clean, organized, and presentation\-ready condition at all times.
* Set up and refresh showroom displays and cases to reflect current collections and priorities.
* Coordinate showroom needs ahead of buyer appointments, trunk shows, and other visits.
* Ensure showroom merchandise is properly received, secured, tagged, and accounted for in accordance with established SOPs.
* Monitor and maintain showroom supplies, fixtures, and presentation materials.

Inventory Coordination \& Tracking

* Maintain and organize jewelry inventory and product samples, including SWP inventory, with ongoing tracking across locations (office, trunk shows, wholesale accounts, consignment).
* Conduct and support physical inventory counts, reconciling discrepancies and maintaining inventory accuracy.
* Maintain inventory records and tracking systems, flagging low stock, aging inventory, or missing items.
* Receive incoming packages and merchandise, ensuring items are properly documented, tagged, and routed.
* Pack, prepare, and ship jewelry for customer orders, wholesale accounts, trunk shows, events, and other business needs.

E\-Commerce \& Digital Merchandising

* Maintain and update product listings, pricing, and inventory counts on Shopify and the company website.
* Maintain and organize product photography and other digital assets, coordinating with the team on shoot needs.
* Support digital merchandising efforts, including product catalog organization and online presentation.
* Update product pricing and details across line sheets, Shopify, the website, and internal documents as directed.

Office \& Merchandise Support

* Maintain merchandise, including product tagging, displays, line sheets, and cleaning/repairs coordination as needed.
* Assist with maintaining office\-wide calendars and schedules. **Order and maintain office, shipping, and packaging supplies.**
* Maintain an organized, clean, and functional office and inventory workspace.
* Assist with updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other internal documentation.
* Assist with special projects, data entry, research, audits, and administrative tasks as needed.
* Run occasional local errands for office and production\-related needs.
* Perform other duties and provide general support to the team as requested.

Qualifications

* 1–2 years of office, administrative, inventory, retail operations, or e\-commerce experience preferred. **Strong attention to detail and accuracy, especially with inventory tracking.**
* Highly organized with the ability to prioritize multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Dependable and able to follow instructions and established processes from start to finish.
* Comfortable working with and handling high\-value merchandise with care.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take initiative.
* Able to work effectively in a small, fast\-paced team environment.
* Comfortable maintaining confidential and sensitive company information.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.
* Experience with Shopify, inventory management systems (e.g., Zedonk), or jewelry/fashion operations is a plus.

Physical \& Work Requirements

* Ability to work primarily in an office environment.
* Ability to use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to pack, unpack, organize, and move merchandise and shipping materials as needed.
* Ability to carefully handle small and high\-value jewelry pieces.
* Ability to perform local office or production errands as needed.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in keeping things organized and accurate, notices when something needs attention, and follows through without requiring constant reminders. Because this position works closely with our showroom, fine jewelry inventory, e\-commerce listings, and important company materials, attention to detail, accountability, organization, and reliability are essential.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Compensation: $65,000 – $80,000 annually, depending on experience.


You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You know how good it feels when the systems, the paperwork, and the people all move together without friction, and you're the reason it does.


You're the engine that moves projects forward. You sit at the center of operations and production, across every project instead of inside just one, keeping schedules on track, the paperwork flowing, and the admin noise away from the people who need to be producing. You're organized, you follow through, and you take pride in the details that most people overlook. You catch what everyone else is too close to see.


You'll work directly with our COO and our Director of Operations.

*Race Service is a small, agile team that goes from brief to delivery in days. Operations here isn’t filing paperwork and waiting to be told what's next. It's systems ownership, cross\-project awareness, and catching the thing that's about to slip before it costs anyone money or trust.*

#### **What you’ll be doing**

* Track in\-house and out\-of\-house creator schedules across every active project, catching double\-bookings and conflicts before they become problems.
* Own utilization tracking, checking billed hours against actual work completed for hourly and salaried team members, and flag discrepancies before they reach payroll or a client invoice.
* Own onboarding for new hires and contractors. First\-day logistics, system access, documentation, and making sure people feel set up to succeed from day one.
* Support People Ops: employee records, PTO tracking, leave requests, benefits and compliance documentation.
* Partner directly with COO and Dir. of Ops on People \& Culture initiatives, this work that shapes how this place runs, not just the paperwork behind it.
* Own weekly Wrapbook check\-ins for trial\-period hires, keeping onboarding and paperwork on track through the full trial window.
* Support Accounts Receivable, tracking outstanding invoices with account managers internally and Accounts Payable externally so nothing sits unresolved.
* Absorb recurring admin load from Producers, such as overhead Amazon orders, logistics confirmations, vendor follow\-ups.
* Supporting vendor and crew paperwork, Third\-party agreements, Payroll onboarding, W\-9 collection, I\-9 collection, and general contractor setup.
* Set and enforce project naming and numbering conventions, and own hard drive accountability, across all active projects.
* Maintain and organize operational documentation. SOPs, trackers, templates, project folders in Shared Drive.
* Own Shared Drive, Google, and Slack access hygiene on every hire and every departure. When someone joins or leaves, make sure their access is updated.
* Own day\-to\-day coordination with facilities, IT, and general office needs, knowing when to keep leadership out of the loop on things that don't need them.
* Flag where manual processes can be simplified or automated, and bring recommendations forward as we grow.
* This role may involve working outside standard hours and working weekends and holidays.

#### **Who we're looking for**


5–7 years in operations, business operations, or production administration at an agency, production company, or fast\-moving small business, with real ownership of systems.


You've managed multiple concurrent workstreams without losing the thread, and you catch what's off before anyone has to point it out.


You've managed paperwork, vendor communications, and internal coordination across multiple people and projects at the same time.


You're comfortable with ops/HR/finance platforms and tools or you're a fast learner who can get up to speed on systems like Rippling, Wrapbook, Ramp or similar quickly.


Comfortable holding sensitive information, employee records, financial data, system access, and you understand why that trust matters.


You think in systems, not tasks. You see the pattern behind a one\-off problem and fix the pattern.


You're proactive, not reactive. You see what needs to happen next and you do it without being told.


You communicate clearly and follow through relentlessly, including when you need to flag something to someone senior to you.


Proficient in Google Workspace (G\-Suite). Google Sheets, shared drives, and organized folders are your natural habitat.


Responsive, autonomous, and equipped to work in a non\-traditional creative setup.

#### **Bonus if you also bring**


Formal training or prior hands\-on experience handling confidential HR and payroll data.


Experience in office management and/or bookkeeping


Agency or production company background.


Tech\-savvy — you pick up new software quickly and you don't wait for someone to hold your hand through it. We use a mix of tools and you won't always get a tutorial.


A genuine interest in figuring out what should be systematized or automated as a company scales, rather than just running the process as it exists today.

#### **Why Race Service?**


We are an Automotive Culture Hub and Creative Agency. Our mission: reshape automotive culture. We work at the intersection of content, strategy, experiential, and design for some of the most iconic brands in the world.


But what makes us different isn't the clients. It's our people.


We operate like a sports team. Everyone brings their best. Everyone feels the win and the loss together. The work we make isn't just deliverables. It's cultural moments that carry a piece of who we are. We reward initiative, autonomy, and bold thinking.


We believe the work you choose and the people you choose it with define the life you live.


If that sounds like your kind of life, hit apply.

*(Curious what Race Service actually looks like? Check out* *our YouTube channel.**)*

#### **What we offer**

* Health Benefits
* 401(k) plan
* Generous company holiday and PTO Plan
* Weekly Team Lunch
* A proper espresso machine, a team that actually knows how to

jobs.title: Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Assemblymember Sade is looking to host community\-centered and enriching events that bridge her office and legislative priorities with community awareness, engagement, and programming.

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized Event Coordinator to serve as the lead and primary point of contact for a range of events and community engagement activities. These activities include, but are not limited to, town halls, community showcases, resource fairs, receptions, and other constituent\-focused programs.

The ideal candidate has experience in project management, strong problem\-solving skills, and strong communication skills with an understanding of the importance of community\-centered events. The candidate also has the ability to successfully manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

As an Event Coordinator, you will be the driving force behind seamless event operations, ensuring every detail aligns with client expectations and company standards. Join us to craft extraordinary events that leave lasting impressions and elevate our brand presence!

**Responsibilities**

* **Planning \& Coordination Logistics**
* Create detailed event concepts, timelines, task lists, and production schedules.
* Maintain a centralized event planning document, project tracker, or other system to monitor event progress.
* Develop run\-of\-show documents, workshop/session/activity schedules, speaker timelines, and event layout materials.
* Lead the overall planning process for events, meetings, programs, community engagements, and other organizational activities.
* Coordinate event logistics and correspondence with internal and external teams.
* Work closely with the District Director and Team Lead to track event progress and identify outstanding needs.
* **Program** **Coordination** **\&\*** Communications\*
* Track outreach goals, timelines, and progress for attendees, speakers, sponsors, partners, community organizations, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate invitations, save\-the\-dates, registration forms, and follow\-up messages.
* Support effective communication with community partners and event participants.
* Develop briefing materials for speakers, leadership, elected officials, partners, and other participants.
* **Budget** **\&\*** VendorCoordination\*
* Assist with event\-related purchases, including in\-person event materials, prepaid vendors, etc.
* Coordinate with vendors, venues, speakers, volunteers, and other event partners.
* Track event\-related expenses and communicate budget needs or concerns to the appropriate team members.
* **Day\-of Event Support**
* Lead day\-of event execution and serve as the primary point of contact for coordination.
* Oversee registration, venue setup, signage, catering, technology, speakers, vendors, volunteers, and overall event flow.
* Troubleshoot unexpected logistical, technical, or program\-related challenges and make real\-time adjustments when necessary.
* Support effective communication with community partners and event participants.
* Develop briefing materials for speakers, leadership, elected officials, partners, and other participants.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.


Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities, have served over 100 million meals, and continue to grow rapidly. Powered by technology and a network of 1,500\+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

This is a client\-advocacy role—not an individual sales\-quota position. You will learn how each client operates, bring their priorities into our organization, guide difficult conversations, and make sure commitments do not disappear between departments.

You should be technically fluent enough to understand the conversation, ask good discovery questions, recognize common risks, and translate between executives and engineers. You will not be expected to architect solutions or independently scope complex projects; qualified technical resources will own design and validation.

**Strategic Account Manager**
=============================

**About OpenArt**
-----------------


OpenArt is an AI storytelling and visual creation platform used by millions of creators worldwide. We're building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting\-edge AI—enabling anyone to create videos, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination.


Our enterprise platform helps marketing, creative, and studio teams at leading brands, agencies, and entertainment companies accelerate image and video production.


OpenArt was selected as one of five companies in the **2026 Disney Accelerator** and recognized by **Notable Capital’s Prosumer AI 40** as one of the most innovative AI\-native companies.


We believe the future of creativity is AI\-native, and we're shaping that future.

**Why Join OpenArt**
--------------------

* **Work with iconic global companies** — support some of the world’s most recognizable entertainment, media, and consumer brands from day one.
* **Build the strategic account playbook** — help define how OpenArt delivers value, drives adoption, and expands its most important enterprise relationships.
* **High visibility and ownership** — lead the operating cadence for high\-profile accounts and work directly with senior client and internal stakeholders.
* **Small team, massive impact** — your execution will directly influence customer outcomes, renewals, expansion, and OpenArt’s enterprise growth.
* **AI\-native product** — help leading creative organizations adopt cutting\-edge image and video generation technology.
* **High standards, low bureaucracy** — we value judgment, attention to detail, ownership, and speed.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Strategic Account Manager** to lead the day\-to\-day delivery and growth of OpenArt’s largest strategic accounts, including one of the world’s leading entertainment companies.


These relationships demand an exceptional standard of execution. Every email, presentation, deliverable, and meeting must be thoughtful, polished, and client\-ready. You will bring structure to complex, cross\-functional engagements by owning the operating cadence, coordinating internal teams, preparing executive\-level materials, and ensuring consistent follow\-through.


You will work closely with Enterprise GTM, Sales, Product, Studio, Legal, and Security to deliver a seamless client experience. You will also help turn what we learn from our flagship accounts into a repeatable operating playbook for future strategic customers.


This role is ideal for someone trained in a **top\-tier professional services environment** who wants to bring that standard of client service and execution to one of the fastest\-moving companies in AI.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Lead the day\-to\-day operating cadence for OpenArt’s largest strategic accounts, including meetings, agendas, notes, action items, follow\-ups, and deliverable tracking.
* Program\-manage client onboarding and rollouts across multiple business units, stakeholder groups, and concurrent workstreams.

* Coordinate teams across Enterprise GTM, Sales, Product, Studio, Legal, and Security so clients experience one coherent OpenArt.

* Track product usage, adoption, account health, and expansion signals to support renewal and upsell opportunities.
* Partner with commercial leads to identify new use cases, business units, and opportunities to grow each strategic relationship.
* Handle confidential client information, sensitive creative materials, and intellectual property with sound judgment and discretion.
* Document effective processes and improve OpenArt’s strategic account playbook so it can scale across future enterprise customers.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

**Core Requirements**

* Three or more years of experience in a client\-facing role at a **top\-tier professional services organization**, such as management consulting, investment banking, or a leading agency or advisory firm.
* Experience working directly with **Fortune 500 companies** or similarly large and complex enterprise clients.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to produce polished, client\-ready materials.
* Strong program\-management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholder groups.
* Flawless attention to detail and a consistently high standard for written communication, presentations, and meeting preparation.
* Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential information, sensitive creative work, and intellectual property.
* A humble, execution\-first mindset and willingness to take ownership of both strategic and operational work.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving, ambiguous startup environment.
* Genuine interest in AI, creative technology, and the future of content production.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working in or serving the **entertainment, media, advertising, or creative industries**.
* Familiarity with creative production workflows, including campaign production, VFX, studio operations, or post\-production.
* Experience using **HubSpot** or a similar CRM platform.
* Exposure to or active use of AI creative tools.
* Experience helping build or standardize a new account\-management, client\-service, or enterprise delivery function.

**Work Setup**

* Los Angeles, California.

**Job Description – Speakman Strategic Account Manager – Industrial Safety – Western Territory** *For more than 150 years, Speakman has been a trusted manufacturer of innovative plumbing fixtures and hospitality solutions, recognized for exceptional performance, quality, and reliability. As part of Everflow, Speakman continues to build on that legacy through continued investment in our products, people, and customer partnerships.* *Our culture is built around collaboration, accountability, and growth. We move with purpose, think like owners, and believe every team member plays an important role in driving success. As we continue to grow, we're looking for motivated people who want to make an impact and help shape the future of the Speakman brand.* **Position Summary**  

As the **Strategic Account Manager, Industrial Safety** for Speakman, you will lead and manage complex customers within a specific Industrial Safety Channel Focus (that cross over multiple District’s on the West Coast). Your primary responsibilities will include formulating and executing strategies, overseeing financial metrics, and enhancing customer relationships. You will collaborate with regional and divisional offices and work closely with field sales teams to implement initiatives and drive business growth.  

  

The ideal candidate is someone who has a strong knowledge of and experience in the Industrial Safety Channel, with sales routes to market, as well as specific experience in the building and construction industry, particularly with large national accounts.  



  

This position is remote based with preference that the individual live near a major airport in the West Region. LAX, PHX, SAN, SFO, PDX, SEA or DEN.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and implement sales plans, encompassing market analysis, account opportunities, short and long\-term goals, strategic initiatives, and measurable outcomes including individual account plans, specification and upgrade recommendations, and sales strategies for Speakman Safety products.
* Build and nurture relationships with key decision\-makers and stakeholders across the business to retain existing business, secure national specifications, and improve margins.
* Gain a deep understanding of each strategic account's business and its critical performance metrics, collaborating with the customer to acquire essential information and assess opportunities.
* Analyze data and trends to develop insights that enhance customer retention, drive incremental revenue, and create a competitive advantage.
* Ensure timely and effective responses to customer needs by mobilizing the organization, facilitating cross\-functional involvement, and including relevant departments to benefit the customer.
* Monitor and maintain consistent communication with relevant parties.
* Coordinate the allocation of organizational resources to maximize sales opportunities.
**Required*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience, MBA preferred
* Minimum of 7 years of proven sales or relevant experience.
* Implicit understanding of focus channel sales route to market.
* Proficient in MS Office Suites.
* Ability to travel 75% or 3 weeks out of the month.
 **Preferred**  

Large national account and sales experience in manufacturing and building products. **Target Compensation Range:** The posted pay range of **$130,000\-$150,000** represents the anticipated hiring range for this position. Individual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, education, certifications, geographic location, market conditions, internal compensation practices, and other job\-related business considerations, consistent with applicable law.

 **Why Speakman,** ***an Everflow Company***

*At Speakman, we believe great companies are built by great people. We are committed to creating a culture where employees feel supported, empowered, and connected to the work they do every day.*

*We value people who think like owners, move with urgency, work collaboratively, and follow through on their commitments. As a growing organization, we offer opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow your career alongside a team that is passionate about serving customers and building long\-term success together.*

***Benefits****: Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, company\-sponsored retirement plans, and additional programs designed to support our employees and their families. Most importantly, we strive to create a workplace where people feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.*

*Everflow is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
**What We Offer**

Commission\-only, no base \- Just close 4 deals per month to earn $170,000\+/ year OTE. After 12 months estimated $26,400\+/m recurring monthly.

Uncapped earnings based on sales commissions. Car allowance provided. No base salary offered at this time.

**About IOI Solutions**

We are an elite Automotive Marketing agency in Los Angeles. We help high\-end automotive shops attract customers and scale up their revenue with our digital marketing services. Auto shops choose IOI for our goal\-obsessed approach, transparent measurement of revenue, and proven track\-record of success. We're also uniquely Automotive only.

We work with Auto Body shops, Detailers, Car Dealerships, PPF shops, Vehicle Wraps, Window Tints, Clubs and events, and more.

**Role Summary**

The **Outside Sales Representative Role** is key for attracting high\-value business owners to become clients at IOI. The objective is to meet with new prospects and close deals. You will be working alongside founder of IOI, hitting the pavement together to build up the initial sales momentum.

You will meet with managers, owners, and decision makers, building rapport and asking discovery questions to position IOI as excellent value to the business. You will have all necessary training, insights, and sales materials to close deals.

From these visits you will own the sales process until the client closes into booked revenue. Keeping tracking CRM notes and follow up meetings. Once client closes into booked revenue, you will be paid commission.

Outside of visiting local shops, if interested, you may do conferences and networking meetups as part of out outbound efforts to meet with top clientele. You will work closely with IOI's leadership team on which shops to focus on, sales strategy, proposals, positioning, and closing.

**Your Experience \& Background**

* College Degree preferred or 3\+ years high\-ticket sales experience
* Proven experience closing deals, ideally at least $30,000 in contract value.
* Based in Los Angeles with Reliable transportation

**Capabilities:**

* **Executive Communication:** Clear, confident communicator who can translate performance into business impact.
* **Growth Mindset:** Continuously seeks better ways to close more deals.
* **Physical:** Comfortable spending a significant portion of the workday traveling throughout Los Angeles
* **Confidence:** Comfortable walking into businesses without an appointment and asking for the owner.
* **Organized:** Self\-directed and capable of planning day based on current sales pipeline and responding to client messages to drive appointments.

**Success Metrics**

* 4 New Clients Per Month
* 5\-10 New Prospects Met Per Day
* Total booking value

Uncapped earnings, so if you close more deals or higher contract values, you earn more.

**Who You Are**

* Competitive, ambitious, and highly motivated by performance\-based compensation
* Excellent relationship building and interpersonal skills
* Strong sales instincts and ability to move conversations toward a decision
* Persistent and comfortable following up repeatedly without becoming discouraged by rejection
* Self\-directed and capable of managing your own territory and daily activity

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience with Automotive such as Car Dealership sales.
* Experience in outbound sales, outside sales, field sales, business development.
* Certifications from Jeremy Miner or any notable sales trainer.

**Culture \& Fit Traits**

* **Trusted Advisor Mentality:** Builds durable client relationships grounded in integrity and impact.
* **Client\-Obsessed:** Prioritizes client outcomes and long\-term partnership value.
* **Collaborative:** Works seamlessly across teams and disciplines.
* **Resilient \& Adaptable:** Thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment.
* **IOI DNA:** Operates with precision, ownership, and a bias toward action.

Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
