jobs.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI E-commerce Operations System
jobs.description:
### **The Opportunity**


FutureSight is seeking a Co\-Founder \& CEO to lead Omnex, an AI\-native operating system for multi\-channel ecommerce sellers, currently in build at our studio. This is a co\-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.


Today's e\-commerce businesses run on fragmented software and manual coordination. Sellers operating across Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, and other channels constantly switch between dashboards, reconcile conflicting data, and make hundreds of operational decisions every day across pricing, inventory, advertising, fulfillment, and customer support.


The opportunity sits within a global ecommerce market exceeding $1 trillion in annual GMV, where millions of sellers increasingly operate across multiple channels but lack any unified operational intelligence layer.

### **Market Context**


Omnex replaces this fragmented workflow with an autonomous, multi\-agent AI workforce. Instead of giving sellers another dashboard, Omnex continuously understands the business, reasons across every sales channel, and proactively executes operational decisions—from optimizing pricing and inventory to managing advertising, forecasting demand, and coordinating customer support. Every AI agent shares the same business context, learns from outcomes, and works together to optimize the business as a whole.

### **About FutureSight**


FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.


You’ll co\-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E\&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co\-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow\-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0\-to\-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

### **The Partnership**

* Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
* Pre\-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow\-on funding
* Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
* Investor and advisor network across logistics, vertical AI, and early\-stage capital markets
* A true co\-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross\-functional team as your partner

### **What you'll own**


As Co\-Founder \& CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

* Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
* Customer Development — Lead pilots with ecommerce sellers, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go\-to\-market motion
* Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
* Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
* Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

### **Co\-Founder Profile**

* Previous founding experience at a venture\-backed company
* Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go\-to\-market, including sales and customer engagement
* Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
* Clear\-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co\-founding a venture\-backed company
* Direct experience in ecommerce — operated a multi\-channel business, sold software into this market, or built tools for ecommerce sellers at scale
* Network within the ecommerce seller community (Amazon sellers, Shopify operators, 3PL partners)

### **How to Apply**


Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.


FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Sales Representative - Walnut Creek, CA
jobs.description:
**About Zedcor Inc.**



Zedcor Inc. (TSX\-V:ZDC) is disrupting the traditional physical security industry through its proprietary MobileyeZ™ security towers by providing turnkey and customized mobile surveillance and live monitoring solutions to blue\-chip customers across North America. The Company continues to expand its established platform of over 1,200 MobileyeZ™ towers in Canada and the United States, with emphasis on industry leading service levels, data\-supported efficiency outcomes, and continued innovation. Zedcor services the Canadian market through equipment and service centers currently located in British Columbia, Alberta, Manitoba, and Ontario. The Company continues to advance its U.S. expansion which now has the capacity to service markets throughout the Midwest with locations throughout Texas Colorado, Arizona, Nevada and Florida.



For more information, check out www.zedcor.com.

 **Position Overview**



Zedcor is looking to add to our existing sales organization in the **Walnut Creek, CA** area. **We are looking to hire Sales Representative**. Sales Representatives are a crucial position as we continue to execute our growth strategy throughout the state of California. This position is perfect for you if you have excellent interpersonal skills, are confident, articulate, ambitious, adaptable and are not scared to share your ideas to push the company forward. In exchange for your talents, we offer an attractive base salary, a company vehicle, great benefits, the opportunity to work as part of a growing team and most importantly, an industry leading uncapped commission plan. This role is responsible for securing new customers and successfully managing the sales pipeline required to achieve a plan.

 **Key Responsibilities**


* You have a large existing network in, but not limited to, the construction, Petrochemical, renewable, Energy and infrastructure sectors.
* Travel to client locations within a designated territory to meet with clients, educate clients on Zedcor services and complete sales contracts.
* Follow up on sales leads generated through website, lead generation tools, networking, phone calls or other sources.
* Prospect potential customers use various direct methods such as cold\-calling, face to face meetings, and indirect methods such as B2B sales.
* Communicate proactively with all customers quarterly, to strengthen and expand relationships.
* Complete weekly sales reports, ensuring KPI’s are met or exceeded.
* Gather market data on pricing, client needs, client size, etc.
* Adhere to processes and contract terms as determined by management.
* Develop an intimate knowledge of product offerings and become an expert on providing solutions to solve client problems.
* Build, develop and maintain profitable business partnerships and relationships which promote long\-term success for both client and Zedcor.
* Attend trade shows/training sessions when necessary to learn about new products and grow knowledge of product offerings.
* Establish and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Work with management to develop and monitor sales strategy and KPIs.
* Complete CRM daily inputting to have a clear pipeline of new business.
* Perform other duties as requested.

  


**Qualifications \& Requirements**


* Strong hunting skills with a focus on building new business.
* Ability to present in large group settings.
* 3\+ years of professional sales experience in business development or B2B sales.
* Prior outside sales in equipment rental solutions to multiple industries considered an asset.
* Knowledge of the security industry, and specifically industrial camera solutions, is beneficial but willing to train the right candidate.
* Excellent professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships with customers, problem solve and provide solutions.
* Strong negotiation skills
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Suite including Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Self\-Starter, driven and motivated to work independently with little oversight.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced competitive environment that is results\-driven.
* Proven track record in prospecting, qualifying, and closing accounts over the phone and in person.
* Successful relationship building \- external and internal.
* Sound decision making and strategic thinking.
* Experience in CRM software
* Strong ability to work independently to efficiently manage the assigned territory and accounts.
* Candidate must be willing to travel in assigned territory– approximately 90% of your time will be outside of the office within your territory being home almost every night, some overnight travel will be required on a case\-by\-case basis.
* Class C driver’s license with clean drivers abstract required.
* Full Background check required.
* **Must be based in Walnut Creek, CA**.

  


**Why Join Zedcor?**



At Zedcor, you won’t just maintain systems, you’ll help build and shape the future of security technology. We provide the tools, mentorship, and the environment to help you thrive and grow in your career. If you’re looking to take your skills to the next level, Zedcor offers a dynamic and rewarding opportunity.

jobs.title: Office and Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**AVT Integration Inc. \| San Ramon, CA \| Full\-time, in person**

$25–$36 per hour, depending on relevant experience and skills and how you develop the position

Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m.

Do you get satisfaction from making things run smoothly? Keeping track of the details, finding an answer, or making sure someone has what they need before they have to ask?

AVT is looking for someone to help keep our office, projects, and field team organized—and grow with us.

About AVT

Since 1984, AVT has designed and installed technology for higher\-end homes throughout the Bay Area, including lighting control, motorized shades, audio/video, networks, security, and related systems.

We’re a small team of about nine people. You’ll work directly with the partners and technicians, experiencing daily how your work helps the whole business. Average age of tenure at AVT is 10\-15 years. We have two workers over 25 years with the company, one over 20, one over 10 and one over 10 person in this position was here 7\.

We feel like it’s a good place to work, grow and enjoy your job.

Your background

**You don’t need experience in residential technology to apply**. Office administration, hospitality, customer service, purchasing, scheduling, or other coordination experience could all be useful**. We’re also open to someone earlier in their career who brings sound judgment, organization, and a wi**llingness to learn.

You should communicate clearly and be comfortable with email, basic spreadsheets, and learning new systems. Tell us what you’ve handled and figured out—even if your experience doesn’t come with an office\-manager title.

What you will do

Based in our San Ramon office, you’ll help connect the people, equipment, and information that keep projects moving. Your responsibilities will include:

· Coordinating schedules and communicating updates.

· Write PO’s, tracking orders, and following up on outstanding items.

· Keeping job records and documentation organized and current.

· Handling calls and email from clients, vendors, and the team.

· Helping resolve everyday problems and making sure loose ends get finished.

· Finding practical ways to make our office processes work better.

· Occasionally running local errands, picking up supplies, or delivering an item to a job site using your own vehicle. Business mileage is reimbursed.

There are established responsibilities to learn and own. Beyond those, the role has room to develop around your abilities, interests, and the needs of the business, as we plan to grow to 12\-14 employees within the next 3 years.

Some days the office is active. Other days much of the team is out on installations, and you may work alone for a substantial part of the day. Being comfortable and productive in both situations matters.

**What makes someone a good fit**

We’re interested in how you approach things, including whether you:

· Show up reliably, follow through on commitments, and communicate when something needs attention.

· Notice what needs doing and take sensible action.

· Ask useful questions, try things, and recognize when it’s time to get help.

· Own mistakes and learn from them.

· Keep track of several moving pieces without needing someone to check every step.

· Work comfortably with different personalities and speak up when you need information or support.

· Enjoy learning software and technology that make your work easier and or more productive

Practical requirements

Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Due to daily morning company team meeting start time and punctuality non\-negotiable. While overtime is unusual it is expected when circumstances warrant

Ability to receive deliveries, open roll up door and lift 50 pounds minimum

For occasional unscheduled business errands, a valid driver’s license, daily reliable personal vehicle, and current auto insurance are required. Business mileage for these types of errands is reimbursed at current IRS rate.

Pay and benefits

· $25–$36 per hour, based on relevant experience and demonstrated skills.

· Employee Kaiser medical premium fully paid by AVT.

· Ten days of combined paid time off annually for vacation, illness, or personal needs, beginning in your first year; increasing to fifteen days beginning in year ten.

· Six to seven paid holidays annually.

· Additional unpaid time off considered when needed, subject to scheduling and coverage.

· Partial matching 401K after probation period

· Access to discounted other insurances for dental, disability and life

· Potential ability to bring pet to work under certain criteria if not distracting (no farm or zoo animals over 100 pounds)

We believe pay should reflect what you bring to the job, and people need time for life outside work.

How to apply

Send your résumé through Indeed, along with a brief note telling us what interests you about this role. Include one example of something you organized, improved, or figured out. It can come from work, school, volunteering, or another part of your life. No formal cover letter needed.

We’ll start with a roughly 30\-minute phone conversation. If there’s mutual interest, we’ll invite you to our San Ramon office to talk more about the work and meet

Pay: $24\.00 \- $36\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

JOB PURPOSE:
  

Conduct clinical research and work independently on progressively more complex projects/assignments. Independently manage significant and key aspects of a large study or all aspects of one or more small research studies.
  

  

CORE DUTIES:
  

Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
  

Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.

Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions, and respond to requests and questions.
  

Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
  

Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
  

Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
  

Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study document to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
  

Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.

Bachelor's degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Strong interpersonal skills.
  

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
  

Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
  

Knowledge of medical terminology.

2\+ years

Oncology treatment trials, Phase I, EPIC and onsite at a health institution (not looking for CRO or Pharma CRA experience)

jobs.title: Portfolio Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
The Portfolio Operations Coordinator is a highly organized, execution\-focused role responsible for keeping work moving across a portfolio of roughly a dozen properties at once. This is not a strategic or sophisticated project management role, it is “block and tackle”: getting into the weeds of every open item, following up relentlessly, and making sure nothing stalls without someone noticing.

**Description**  
The Portfolio Operations Coordinator is a highly organized, execution\-focused role responsible for keeping work moving across a portfolio of roughly a dozen properties at once. This is not a strategic or sophisticated project management role, it is “block and tackle”: getting into the weeds of every open item, following up relentlessly, and making sure nothing stalls without someone noticing.The Coordinator is a really, really good administrator who wants to be more, someone who stays on top of every small, nitty\-gritty detail, but who also carries the standing authority to tell people what needs to happen next and hold them to it. This is not an assistant role taking instructions; it's an enforcement role, asking “what's the status, why hasn't this moved, did this get done, what needs to happen next” until every property is humming along. The Coordinator reports on progress clearly and consistently, and is expected to grow into greater ownership as their judgment and process knowledge develop.

**Key Outcomes**  
**Relentless Follow\-Up \& Status Ownership**  
\- Track every open item across the full property portfolio so nothing quietly falls behind.

\- Maintain a single, current source of truth (tracker or log) for every open item, deliverable, and deadline across all properties

\- Proactively check status rather than waiting to be asked: “what's the status,” “why hasn't this moved,” “did this get done,” “what's next”

\- Flag stalled or at\-risk items immediately, before they become someone else's emergency

\- Follow up with the same discipline on the tenth property as the first

**Process Enforcement \& Accountability**

**\-** Hold people to the process and to their commitments, with real authority to do so.

\- Enforce established processes and checklists consistently across every property, rather than letting exceptions slide

\- Tell contributors and vendors what needs to happen next, and hold them accountable to it — not simply relay instructions

\- Escalate clearly and quickly when someone isn't moving, rather than absorbing the delay quietly

\- Notice when a process is being skipped or shortcut and correct course before it compounds

**Detail Ownership \& Administrative Execution**

**\-** Own the nitty\-gritty work that keeps every property running cleanly.

\-Manage the detailed administrative work, documentation, scheduling, data entry, filing, paperwork, that underlies each property's progress

\- Catch small errors and gaps before they become bigger problems

\- Keep records, trackers, and files organized, accurate, and current

**Cross\-Portfolio Coordination**

**\-** Keep roughly a dozen properties moving at once without letting any one property stall the rest.

\- Serve as the connective point between the people, teams, and vendors involved in each property's work

\- Juggle multiple simultaneous workstreams without losing track of any single one

\- Communicate clear, structured status updates to leadership on where each property stands

**Growth Toward Greater Ownership**

**\-** Build toward more independent judgment as experience develops.

\- Build process knowledge and pattern\-recognition across properties over time

\- Surface recurring bottlenecks and suggest process improvements as they emerge

\- Take on greater independent decision\-making as trust and track record build

**Competencies**  
**Extreme Organization \& Detail Orientation**  
*Supports: nothing falling through the cracks across a busy, multi\-property portfolio*

\- Tracks a high volume of small details accurately and simultaneously

\- Notices gaps or inconsistencies that others miss

\- Keeps personal and shared systems (trackers, logs, files) clean and current  
**Follow\-Up \& Persistence**

*Supports: work actually getting done, not just assigned*

\- Follows up repeatedly and without being prompted until an item is resolved

\- Does not let a lack of response become a dropped thread

\- Applies the same follow\-up discipline regardless of how many properties are in flight

**Process Enforcement**

*Supports: consistency and quality across every property, not just the squeaky\-wheel ones*

\- Applies checklists and standard processes the same way every time

\- Catches and corrects deviations before they become patterns

\- Balances firmness on process with professionalism in how it's delivered

**Accountability\-Driving (Without Formal Authority)**

*Supports: work actually moving, even without direct reports*

\- Comfortable telling colleagues, vendors, or partners what needs to happen next

\- Holds people to commitments and deadlines directly, not just reports that they've missed them

\- Distinguishes between assisting and directing, and operates confidently in the latter

**Multi\-Workstream Management**

*Supports: parallel progress across roughly a dozen properties*

\- Manages many concurrent, independent workstreams without losing track of status on any one

\- Prioritizes across competing demands without dropping lower\-priority items entirely

\- Scales personal systems and habits as the portfolio grows

**Communication \& Status Reporting**

*Supports: leadership always having an accurate, picture*

\- Reports status clearly, concisely, and honestly — including bad news \- Adjusts tone and detail appropriately between vendors, colleagues, and leadership

\- Documents decisions and next steps so nothing depends on memory

**Initiative \& Growth Mindset**

*Supports: growing from execution into greater ownership over time*

jobs.title: Publicity Coordinator (PH), Searchlight Pictures

Searchlight Pictures is a global specialty film and television company that develops, produces, finances and acquires motion pictures and series for both worldwide theatrical and streaming releases. It has its own marketing and distribution operations, and is part of The Walt Disney Studios, a division of The Walt Disney Company. Founded in 1994 as Fox Searchlight Pictures, the company’s titles have grossed over $5 billion worldwide, amassing 52 Academy Awards including five Best Picture winners since 2009: Slumdog Millionaire, 12 Years a Slave, Birdman, The Shape of Water, and Nomadland; 64 BAFTA Awards; 35 Golden Globe Awards, and 10 Grammy Awards.

  

The company includes Searchlight Television, the division which develops and produces series for streaming, network, and cable partners, and earned a Primetime Emmy Award for Best Actress for its first production “The Dropout'' from Elizabeth Meriwether, in partnership with Hulu and 20th Studios. Searchlight Television also produced the limited series “La Máquina,” with Gael García Bernal and Diego Luna.

  

The Publicity Coordinator plays a key role in supporting film publicity campaigns by managing logistics, coordinating with internal and external partners, and ensuring smooth execution of press and promotional events. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively across departments and with external vendors.

jobs.title: Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Events Coordinator**
======================

* CAMPAIGN FINANCE BOARD


Posted on


09/30/2026


* Full\-time


Location


MANHATTAN


* No exam required


Department


Managerial


Salary range: $60,001\.00 – $64,999\.00
Save


**Job Description**
-------------------


ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN FINANCE BOARD
  

  

The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.
  

  

We make it easier for New Yorkers to vote, meaningfully support candidates for city office, and run for office themselves. NYC Votes, our voter engagement initiative, meets people where they are to share trustworthy election information and help New Yorkers make a plan to vote. We publish the citywide Voter Guide, which delivers information about candidates directly to voters’ doors. Our public matching funds program ensures small contributions can make a big difference, allowing regular people to run for office by relying on the support of other regular people, not just wealthy donors and special interests. And we lift the veil on how candidates raise and spend money, increasing transparency and accountability in local government.
  

  

We believe that when every New Yorker is empowered to participate meaningfully in elections, candidates will better reflect the communities they serve, elected leaders will be more accountable to the public, and New Yorkers will have a democracy they can truly trust.
  

  

ABOUT THE UNIT
  

  

PUBLIC AFFAIRS DIVISION
  

  

The Public Affairs division engages New Yorkers, informs them about elections, and boosts their participation in the democratic process. We make election information accessible and relevant, increase engagement with underrepresented communities, and cultivate a team that reflects our core values of purpose, curiosity, creativity, and collaboration.
  

  

The division includes Marketing and Digital Communications, Community Engagement, Language Access, and Public Relations. Our division’s work includes publishing the citywide Voter Guide, running the official citywide Debates Program, and managing the voter engagement initiative, NYC Votes.
  

  

PUBLIC RELATIONS UNIT
  

  

The Public Relations unit leads messaging and strategy for internal and external communications and oversees the citywide Debates program as well as Board meetings and other events. The team works with journalists to land and shape coverage of campaign finance and election matters, and it works to strengthen communications inside the agency through collaboration with other units on the rollout of internal policies, identifying new ways to share and present internal updates, and creating new channels for engagement and building shared understanding of our work and mission.
  

  

JOB DESCRIPTION
  

  

The Events Coordinator will report to the Events Manager in the Public Relations Unit and will be responsible for driving logistics in the planning, coordination, and execution of internal and external CFB events including official monthly Campaign Finance Board meetings, staff meetings, and the official NYC Debates Program in years with an election for citywide office.
  

  

The Public Affairs division and Public Relations unit are dynamic and talented teams; this role offers growth potential and opportunities to learn about all facets of our work, including the city’s public matching funds program, the NYC Votes initiative to engage communities underserved by electoral outreach and local democracy, and policy recommendations to make New York City’s government more open, equitable, and transparent.
  

  

The person in this role will work closely with the Public Relations team, other Public Affairs division staff, and external stakeholders to ensure CFB events reflect the highest agency and industry standards. The ideal candidate will enjoy working collaboratively, effectively manage multiple workstreams at once, and believe in the mission of strengthening democracy in New York City.
  

  

The responsibilities and tasks to be completed in this role include, but are not limited to:
  

  

\- Support in the planning and execution of CFB hosted events \- for both internal staff and external attendees \- at external venues outside of the CFB office.
  

  

* Coordinating virtual and hybrid event logistics to ensure live streaming, Q\&A functions, accessibility support including American Sign Language (ASL) and language interpretation services, archival recordings, and other elements are executed seamlessly.

  

* Providing training and prep materials for participants in CFB events such as runs\-of\-show executed to the highest degree of detail and professionalism.

  

* Collaborating across the Public Affairs division to expand agency\-wide best practices for engaging, inclusive, accessible events that further our mission.

  

MOST ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES \& OTHER BEHAVIORS (KSAOs)

jobs.title: Meeting & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**
As a CBRE Meeting \& Events Coordinator, you will assist with the coordination and execution of small to medium meetings, conferences, and events.
This job is part of the Workplace Experience function. They are responsible for providing world\-class customer service to the clients and visitors of a designated building. **What You’ll Do:*** Primary point of contact for smaller meetings and events. Provide support for larger and more complex meetings and events as needed.
* Work with clients, vendors, and team members to coordinate guest services. This includes arrival experience, transportation, signage, displays, special needs requirements, printing, and event security.
* Create a hospitable environment for attendees, event owners, and vendors on the day of the event.
* Assist with conference room turnover and midday room refresh. Reconfigure rooms for evening indoor and outdoor spaces. Take direction from senior team members.
* Respond to event activities such as gathering event supplies, equipment needs, food \& beverage services, facility security, etc.
* Conduct room set up, refresh, and removal of food, beverage, and service items. Maintain outlines of small space configurations, decor possibilities, and event\-related event items.
* Complete room checks and ensure technical and visual spaces are functional. Troubleshoot audio and technical issues.
* Manage a small inventory of event supplies.
* Coordinate master meeting and events calendar for small to medium\-sized event spaces. Communicate events schedule with team and service providers.
* Assist with post\-event reporting and reconciliation. Escalate potential issues and concerns as appropriate.
* Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems while having a limited opportunity to exercise discretion.
* Impact through clearly defined duties, methods, and tasks are described in detail.
* Deliver own output by following defined procedures and processes under close supervision and guidance.
**What You’ll Need:*** High School Diploma or GED with up to 2 years of job\-related experience.
* Fulfill the physical requirements associated with this role. This includes stooping, standing, walking, and climbing stairs. Must be able to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more.
* Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
* Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
**Why CBRE?**
When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.**Applicant AI Use Disclosure**
We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Meeting \& Events Coordinator position is $64,000 annually \[or $30\.77 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Meeting \& Events Coordinator position is $66,560 annually \[or $32\.00 per hour]. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.  

**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  

  

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at \+1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and \+1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

EOC Administrative Coordinator \- Finance Office (BEOC)


**POSITION DETAILS**


The State University of New York Brooklyn Educational Opportunity Center (BEOC), administered by New York City College of Technology/CUNY, provides tuition\-free academic and workforce development training to eligible New York State residents, supporting college access, employment, and economic self\-sufficiency.


Reporting to the EOC Director of Finance, the EOC Administrative Coordinator – Finance Office provides day\-to\-day administrative support for purchasing, invoices, budget tracking, fiscal records, and business\-office follow\-up. The position maintains organized documentation and tracks requests through completion; fiscal approvals and institutional commitments remain with authorized officials.


In addition to the CUNY Title Overview, responsibilities include:


* Receive and review purchase requests, invoices, vendor forms, and supporting documents for completeness; maintain a central request and follow\-up log showing status, responsible parties, and deadlines.
* Collect quotations and required documentation, route requests for approval, track purchase orders, deliveries, and invoice status, and follow up with departments and vendors on outstanding items.
* Maintain budget, expenditure, and commitment trackers under the Director of Finance's direction; prepare routine status reports and flag variances or overdue items for review.
* Assist with routine reconciliations by compiling records, matching supporting documents, identifying discrepancies, and referring exceptions to the Director of Finance.
* Maintain organized contract, renewal, invoice, receipt, and fiscal\-reporting records; flag upcoming deadlines and help assemble documentation for audits and reporting.
* Coordinate with Operations and the appropriate City Tech offices to obtain missing fiscal or payroll\-support documentation; document follow\-up and escalate unresolved requests to the Director of Finance.
* Respond to routine business\-office inquiries, provide status updates and approved procedural guidance, and refer approval, policy, and payment decisions to the responsible official.
* Maintain approved shared files, forms, and operating procedures to support continuity and cross\-training; prepare meeting materials and correspondence and assist with assigned business\-office projects.

**QUALIFICATIONS**


Bachelor's degree required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience supporting a finance office, purchasing, accounts payable, budget administration, or a comparable administrative function.
* Strong spreadsheet, data\-entry, recordkeeping, organizational, and customer\-service skills; ability to manage competing deadlines and confidential records.
* Familiarity with higher\-education or public\-sector administrative processes and financial systems preferred.

**CUNY TITLE OVERVIEW**


Supports projects, initiatives, and activities within an Educational Opportunity Center (EOC).


* Organizes office functions such as communications, meeting schedules, work plans, staff assignments, and distributing information
* Collects data for, prepares, and distributes reports and presentations using word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software
* Updates office databases, lists, and files to ensure completeness and accuracy; maintains current information on department web site(s); maintains department archives and collections
* Conducts internet and/or database research and performs basic systems queries to locate information related to department activities
* Maintains department fiscal plans and budgets; assists in budget administration and invoice processing
* Provides basic information, instructions, and materials as requested by students, faculty, and others who contact the department
* May supervise office staff and student workers
* Performs related duties as assigned.

**Position Overview**

Randi Rahm Atelier, a New York\-based couture fashion house specializing in handcrafted, one\-of\-a\-kind eveningwear, bridal, and custom designs, is seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented **Studio/Production Coordinator** to oversee daily atelier operations, coordinate production, and support the creative and administrative functions of the business.

This is a hands\-on, multifaceted role requiring a strong understanding of the luxury fashion industry, garment construction, textiles, and the intricacies of operating a boutique couture house. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver who can balance production management, studio operations, client relations, social media, and creative development while taking the lead in managing a team of interns. The position requires someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, takes initiative, and is comfortable managing multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced setting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Coordination:** Coordinate production from initial development through completion, working closely with the designer and production team to establish timelines, maintain quality standards, and ensure deadlines are met.
* **Creative \& Design Development:** Assist with embroidery and beading layout development in collaboration with the designer and communicating with vendors to ensure projects are completed accurately and in a timely manner.
* **Production Costing \& Order Management:** Maintain sewing hours, production records, and detailed costing sheets. Prepare, process, and manage sales orders and purchase orders.
* **Fabric \& Vendor Management:** Oversee fabric sourcing, while organizing vendor information, purchasing orders, and suppliers communications.
* **Client Relations:** Support client communications and manage scheduling and follow\-up, ensuring an exceptional level of service consistent with a luxury couture house.
* **Social Media Management:** **Public Relations \& Social Media:** Coordinate ongoing PR collaborations while maintaining relationships with stylists, media contacts, and other industry professionals. Oversee the atelier's social media presence, including content planning, creation, scheduling, and publishing.
* **Internship Management \& Leadership:** Recruit, organize, and lead a team of interns, overseeing their schedules, assigning responsibilities, coordinating projects, and providing guidance and supervision.
* **Studio \& Operations Management:** Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of the atelier, maintaining an organized, efficient, and productive studio environment. Manage administrative functions, digital files, physical records, and general office organization. Provide hands\-on support across all departments, adapting to the evolving needs of the studio and contributing to its overall success.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Minimum 5 years experience within the fashion industry required.
* Previous experience at a luxury fashion house, couture atelier, or within the fashion industry is preferred.
* Knowledge of textiles, fabrics, trims, and sourcing.
* Experience with production coordination, costing, purchase orders, and vendor management.
* Experience managing social media accounts, developing content, and maintaining a consistent brand presence.
* Strong organizational, administrative, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Must be highly adaptable, receptive to constructive criticism, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, demanding environment where attention to detail, resilience, and the ability to take direction are essential.
* Experience supervising, mentoring, or managing interns.
* Computer proficiency and the ability to maintain organized digital files, databases, and physical records.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and take ownership of responsibilities while collaborating across departments.
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset and the flexibility to adapt in a fast\-paced, creative environment.
* A genuine passion for fashion, craftsmanship, and the artistry of couture.

**Compensation:** Salary commensurate with experience.

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Description:
**Job Title:** Event Sales Coordinator  

**Location:** The Ritz\-Carlton New York, NoMad – New York, NY  

**Reports To:** Director of Event Sales / Event Sales Manager  

**Department:** Sales \& Events  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Salary:** $70,000 per year plus benefits

**About José Andrés Group**
---------------------------

  

José Andrés Group (JAG), led by Chef José Andrés, is known for creating exceptional dining experiences through culinary innovation, outstanding hospitality, and a values\-driven culture.


At **The Ritz\-Carlton New York, NoMad**, José Andrés Group brings its distinctive culinary and hospitality approach to a luxury hotel environment, creating memorable experiences for private celebrations, corporate gatherings, social events, and special occasions.


Our Events team works closely with Culinary, Restaurant Operations, Banquets, and hotel partners to deliver highly personalized experiences with exceptional attention to detail.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

  

The **Event Sales Coordinator** plays an integral role in supporting the Event Sales team and ensuring a seamless experience for clients from initial inquiry through event execution and follow\-up.


This position supports the administrative, sales, and planning functions of the department, including responding to inquiries, preparing proposals and contracts, maintaining event details and BEOs, coordinating site visits, tracking deposits and deadlines, and ensuring accurate communication between clients and internal teams.


The ideal candidate is **highly organized, detail\-oriented, polished, responsive, and genuinely passionate about hospitality and events**. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in event sales within a luxury hotel and restaurant environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Event Sales Support**

* Support the Director of Event Sales and Event Sales Managers with incoming event inquiries and sales opportunities.
* Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally according to established JAG standards.
* Assist with qualifying leads and gathering information regarding event dates, guest counts, budgets, event type, and client priorities.
* Prepare proposals, menus, pricing information, presentations, and event materials.
* Assist with scheduling and coordinating site visits, tastings, and client meetings.
* Follow up on inquiries, proposals, contracts, and outstanding event details.
* Maintain awareness of available event spaces, capacities, menus, pricing, and minimums.
* Identify opportunities for additional food, beverage, and event enhancements and communicate them to the sales team.
* Support the sales team in moving qualified opportunities efficiently through the sales pipeline.

### **Client Communication \& Luxury Hospitality**

* Provide warm, polished, responsive, and personalized communication throughout the client experience.
* Serve as a knowledgeable resource for clients regarding event spaces, menus, beverages, timelines, and logistics.
* Gather event preferences, dietary restrictions, special occasions, VIP information, and other important details.
* Maintain professional communication by phone, email, and in person.
* Anticipate client needs and follow up proactively on outstanding information.
* Maintain discretion when supporting VIP, corporate, social, and high\-profile clients.
* Escalate complex requests, negotiations, or concerns to the appropriate Event Sales Manager or Director.
* Represent José Andrés Group and the property with professionalism at all times.

### **Event Planning \& Coordination**

* Assist with coordinating menus, beverage selections, guest counts, floor plans, timelines, audiovisual needs, rentals, entertainment, and special requests.
* Prepare and update proposals, contracts, **Banquet Event Orders (BEOs)**, event summaries, and other event documentation.
* Ensure event details are complete, accurate, and updated according to established deadlines.
* Track deposits, payment schedules, signed contracts, guarantees, and outstanding client information.
* Communicate allergies, dietary restrictions, VIPs, and special requests accurately to internal teams.
* Assist with final event details and last\-minute updates.
* Participate in BEO and event\-detail meetings as required.
* Help ensure a seamless handoff from the sales and planning process to event execution.

### **Sales Administration \& CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate client, lead, and event information within **TripleSeat and other designated CRM/event management systems**.
* Enter and update contacts, event details, proposals, contracts, notes, and follow\-up activities.
* Maintain organized records for contracts, BEOs, menus, deposits, payments, and client correspondence.
* Assist with weekly sales reports, event calendars, lead tracking, pipeline reporting, and forecasting support.
* Track outstanding contracts, deposits, guarantees, and event details.
* Maintain accurate and current event calendars.
* Support the Events team with additional administrative and sales\-related projects as assigned.

### **Site Visits \& Tastings**

* Assist with preparing event spaces and materials for client site visits.
* Coordinate site\-tour appointments and communicate relevant details to internal teams.
* Conduct site tours for prospective clients as assigned and appropriately trained.
* Assist with coordinating and executing client tastings.
* Ensure menus, collateral, floor plans, and other sales materials are current and presentation\-ready.
* Follow up with clients and Sales Managers after tours and tastings to support the sales process.

### **Event Execution**

* Attend and support events as needed to help ensure a successful client experience.
* Assist with client arrival and serve as an additional point of contact when assigned.
* Verify event spaces and details against BEO specifi

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
NYU Langone Health is a fully integrated health system that consistently achieves the best patient outcomes through a rigorous focus on quality that has resulted in some of the lowest mortality rates in the nation. For the fourth consecutive year, Vizient Inc. ranked NYU Langone No. 1 for quality care in the nation and U.S. News \& World Report recently placed 12 of its clinical specialties among the top 10 in the nation. NYU Langone offers a comprehensive range of medical services with one high standard of care across 6 inpatient locations, its Perlmutter Cancer Center, and over 320 outpatient locations in the New York area and Florida. With $14\.2 billion in revenue this year, the system also includes two tuition\-free medical schools, in Manhattan and on Long Island, and a vast research enterprise with over $1 billion in active awards from the National Institutes of Health.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *NYU Langone Health*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X*, *YouTube* *and* *Instagram*.


**Position Summary:**  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Administrative Coordinator.
  

  

In this role, the successful candidate Responsible for coordinating/managing administrative activities for staff and ensures efficient administrative operations.


**Job Responsibilities:**


* Maintains office efficiency by planning and implementing office space, layouts, and equipment needs.
* Designs and implements office policies by establishing standards and procedures; measuring results against standards; making necessary adjustments.
* Completes operational requirements by scheduling and assigning employees; following up on work results.
* Keeps management informed by reviewing and analyzing special reports; summarizing information; identifying trends
* Maintains office staff job results by recruiting, selecting, orienting, and training employees, coaching, counseling, and disciplining; planning, monitoring, and appraising job results.
* Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops.
* Maintains monthly newsletter and sends ad\-hoc communications to staff.
* Demonstrates knowledge of the organization's Core Values and incorporates them into the performance of duties.
* Supports Leadership in problem solving and project planning/coordination to ensure efficient services. Assists in the development and execution of goals and objectives, and serves as a primary point of contact for all administrative issues.
* Maintains schedules/calendars, screens and handles telephone communications; evaluates incoming and outgoing correspondence and prepares responses as appropriate. Organizes and facilitates meetings, conferences, and other special events including Employee Engagement activities, as required, including identifying needed resources and arranging for required support (i.e. Technical, A/V, etc) for meetings and events.
* Researches and analyzes data related to administrative functions: supply/inventory management, payroll, scheduling, budget, clinical/regulatory compliance, etc. Prepares a variety of communications, reports, charts, written documents, etc detailing the findings which may be highly sensitive and confidential in nature.
* Coordinates and oversees the day\-to\-day management of supplies, equipment, and facilities for the office, as appropriate, to include maintenance, inventory management, logistics, security, and related activities.
* Gathers, enters, and/or updates data to maintain departmental records and databases, as appropriate; establishes and maintains files and records for the office.
* Performs other duties as assigned
* Coordinates the day\-to\-day activities of all offices including but not limited to supply/inventory/equipment management, payroll, scheduling, and clinical/regulatory compliance, and refund/correspondence processing. Develops policies, procedures and systems which ensure productive and efficient administrative operations.

  


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's Degree required
* 2 years of relevant experience, or the equivalent combination of education and experience
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication, and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of standard office software is essential, including proficiency with word\-processing, spreadsheet and database software (e.g., Microsoft Office, preferred). Ability to multi\-task and/or coordinate multiple assignments is required.
* Ability to interpret and implement policies and procedures, and effectively communicate detailed information to a diverse population, both verbally and in writing; excellent problem\-solving skills is required.

  


*Qualified candidates must be able to effectively communicate with all levels of the organization.*  

  

NYU Langone Health provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you'll feel good about devoting your time and your talents.



At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it's developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time\-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well\-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

jobs.description:
**Community Coordinator \- M.S. 358 (28Q358\)**
===============================================


* Posted Date: Sep 30, 2026 Deadline: Oct 14, 2026
**Job Details**
---------------


### **Position Summary:**


Under the supervision of the Principal, the Community Coordinator will perform duties related to developing and improving community relations. The Community Coordinator will support the school in its efforts to increase and maintain communication between the school and our students, families, staff, and community partners and other community organizations and high schools and colleges. The Community Coordinator will similarly work to develop and sustain positive relations with other schools in the community and other organizations within the NYC Department of Education. The Community Coordinator will also work with local businesses, corporations and community\-based organizations to solicit interest in supporting and/or providing sites for the school’s fieldwork, internship, community service or community farming programs. Current groups working with the school include: QCH, LiveSchool, PTA, SLT, District Support Team, and various neighboring High Schools. Performs related work.


### **Reports to:**


Principal, Assistant Principal


### **Key Relationships:**


Serves as a liaison between school administration and community groups by coordinating and facilitating communication between the school, staff, students, families, community organizations, businesses, government agencies and the communities that these vital organizations represent.


### **Responsibilities**


* Maintains ongoing contact with community based organizations (CBO’s) that are involved with providing services to support the school’s educational programs.
* Assists students and staff in building relationships with external partners including those connected to the school.
* Meets with community leaders and the administration to plan community events.
* Meets regularly and communicate with community partners to schedule a calendar of events for the fiscal year.
* Coordinates and supervises various outreach programs between the school and the neighboring community.
* Responsible for the supervision, planning, implementation, coordination, and monitoring of community development programs.
* Develops, coordinates and monitors partnerships and community development programs associated with the PTA and CBO’s.
* Prepares evaluation reports; performs analyses; and reviews program plans, funding and performance with various CBO’s.
* Works with our various departments and Parent Association to support and develop the community workshops.
* Prepares correspondence, documents, and other forms of written communication for internal and external community outreach purposes.
* Provides logistical and administrative support to the Parent Coordinator and the Principal related to community outreach and parent engagement.
* Encourages participation from the school’s community groups in recreational activities and assists with the provision of related operational support including outreach to community agencies.

### **Qualification Requirements:**


#### **Minimum**


* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or


* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or


* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to **"1"** or **"2"** above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in **"1"** above.


#### **Preferred**


* Public speaking ability and good people skills.
* Ability to interact with people of all social and economic levels.
* Prior experience in school setting and interaction with students, parents, and school staff.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to work with students, teachers, and supervisors.
* Knowledge of school program objectives.
* Strong literacy skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues when necessary.

### **Work Schedule:**


This is a 12 month, 35 hour per week annual assignment. Position will require flexibility with respect to work hours in order to meet the needs of the school community, including early mornings, evenings and weekends. Use of earned vacation and/or compensatory time is subject to approval of school principal.


### **Salary:**


$62,707 (New Hire Rate)


$72,114 \- $97,343 (Incumbent \- 2 years of full\-time continuous City service)


### **Application:**


Please send cover letter and resume, no later than **October 14, 2026**, to:


Amr Elkarany, Principal

88\-08 164 Street, Queens, NY 11432

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


We believe a workplace food program is something employees should love and look forward to every day. Powered by technology and a network of over 2,000 restaurants, Fooda feeds hungry people at work through our ongoing food programs located within companies and office buildings. Every day, each Fooda location is served by a different restaurant that comes onsite and serves fresh lunch from their chef’s unique menu. Fooda operates in over 20 major US cities and continues its expansion across the United States. Eight out of ten employees believe Fooda is one of their company’s top perks.


Fooda is recruiting for **Event Coordinators** to join our team in markets across the U.S. to support our growing client roster. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with a hospitality or events background who are eager to learn about food service, work with great customers, and support a broad network of excellent local restaurants.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Support Fooda events in a variety of capacities, including: 1\.) being onsite to set\-up, tear down, clean equipment and site areas, problem\-solve, and ensure high quality set\-up and customer experience, 2\.) serve as back\-up cashier at Fooda Cafés for team members who have time off, and 3\.) driver responsibilities, delivering equipment and food to Fooda sites.
* Gain competency with Fooda’s technology and standard operations procedures
* Problem\-solve for issues such as incorrect orders, late deliveries, late restaurant arrivals, or incorrect email communication
* Troubleshoot technical issues with point\-of\-sale (POS) system, onsite technology, and TV menu boards
* Conduct onsite Fooda promotions and mobile app coaching
* Provide real\-time onsite customer service to resolve issues promptly directly with the consumer
* Facilitate audits of restaurant event set\-up to ensure consistency and high quality
* Escalate issues to Operations Manager when necessary to keep them informed or help problem solve
* Critical hours are over lunch (10 am – 2 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am\-4pm, depending on the market and need

 **Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast\-paced start\-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self\-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type\-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part\-time job (between 10\-15 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

**What We’ll Hook You Up With:**

* Competitive wages $20\-$25/hr
* Paid time off
* A flexible part\-time schedule (10\-15 hours per week)
* 401k Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Pre\-tax commuter expense benefit
* Long\-term opportunities for advancement within Fooda
* Networking opportunities for work or career with local restaurants
* A fulfilling, challenging work experience and free food!


Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. No phone calls or recruiters please.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an energetic, motivated, and relationship\-driven **School Sales Representative** to join our growing team! In this role, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and building strong, long\-term relationships with schools, administrators, parent organizations, athletic departments, and other educational organizations.

The ideal candidate is outgoing, organized, and confident communicating with decision\-makers. You will introduce schools to our uniform, apparel, spirit wear, and related product offerings, identify their specific needs, prepare solutions, and guide accounts through the sales process from initial outreach through order completion.

If you enjoy meeting new people, developing relationships, and growing accounts, this is an excellent opportunity to build a rewarding career in school sales.

Duties

* Prospect and generate new school accounts through phone calls, emails, in\-person visits, networking, referrals, and community outreach.
* Build and maintain relationships with school administrators, principals, purchasing departments, parent coordinators, PTA/PTO organizations, athletic departments, and other key decision\-makers.
* Present and sell school uniforms, staff apparel, spirit wear, athletic apparel, promotional products, and other school\-related merchandise.
* Schedule and conduct meetings with prospective and existing school customers to understand their needs, budgets, timelines, and purchasing requirements.
* Prepare product recommendations, pricing, quotes, samples, and sales presentations tailored to each school.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers to answer questions, provide additional information, and move opportunities through the sales process.
* Negotiate pricing and order requirements while maintaining strong customer relationships and company profitability.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer communications, follow\-ups, opportunities, and sales activity using the company's CRM system.
* Manage and grow existing school accounts by identifying additional products and future sales opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal customer service, production, artwork, and order\-processing teams to ensure customer expectations are communicated clearly.
* Attend school events, vendor fairs, conferences, networking events, and other opportunities to promote the company and generate new business.
* Develop strategies to expand sales within assigned territories and reach new schools.
* Stay informed about school purchasing cycles and proactively contact customers ahead of upcoming school years, events, graduations, athletic seasons, and other important deadlines.
* Provide excellent customer service before, during, and after each sale to encourage repeat business and referrals.

Requirements

* Previous experience in outside sales, business development, account management, or customer service is preferred.
* Experience working with schools, uniforms, apparel, promotional products, or educational organizations is a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the confidence to speak with school administrators and other decision\-makers.
* Excellent relationship\-building and customer service skills.
* Strong negotiation and sales\-closing abilities.

External: PR agency, media and publishing partners, event vendors and production partners, shopping centers and retail partners, Wholesale accounts, brand and activation partners.

* Exceptional organizational and project\-management skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, deadlines and stakeholders with limited supervision.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating professionally with both internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build productive relationships across Retail, Wholesale and corporate teams.
* Proactive, resourceful and solutions\-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Strong proofread

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Goodwill Greater New York and Northern New Jersey (GWNYNJ) believes that the power of work and sustainable fashion is how we unlock the good in our communities. For over 100 years, we have helped people get jobs, stay employed, and progress in careers across New York and Northern New Jersey. We believe that diversity drives innovation and strengthens our workplace. We are committed to fostering our inclusive environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities.
  
  

**Job Title:** Account Manager, Sales – Workforce1 Career Centers (Bronx: Fordham \& Hunts Point)
  
**Reports To:** Business Services Manager
  
**Location:** Bronx, NY (Fordham Hub \& Hunts Point Satellite)
  
**Travel Required:** Yes – throughout the five boroughs of New York City
  
  

Position Overview
  
The Sales Account Manager is responsible for business development and employer engagement on behalf of the Workforce1 Career Centers. This position focuses on building and maintaining strong relationships with employers across New York City to identify hiring needs, promote Workforce1 services, and connect businesses with qualified candidates.
  
The ideal candidate is a natural networker who thrives on relationship\-building, understands local labor market trends, and is passionate about helping employers meet their workforce needs while creating opportunities for jobseekers.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Business Development \& Employer Engagement
  
* Conduct proactive outreach to employers, industry associations, and local businesses to identify hiring needs and promote Workforce1 services.
* Develop and maintain long\-term partnerships with employers to drive repeat business and ongoing collaboration.
* Conduct labor market research to identify trends, new business openings, and in\-demand occupations across the five boroughs.
* Attend networking events, business expos, and community meetings to represent Workforce1 and build employer relationships.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date database of employer accounts and contacts within internal systems (e.g., Dynamics).


Partnership \& Collaboration
  
* Collaborate closely with the Recruitment and Career Services teams to ensure that employer job orders are filled with qualified candidates.
* Communicate employer hiring requirements clearly to the Recruitment team and monitor progress toward fulfillment.
* Partner with community\-based organizations, chambers of commerce, and business improvement districts (BIDs) to expand employer outreach.


Performance \& Reporting
  
* Meet or exceed monthly employer engagement and job order targets as set by SBS and internal management.
* Track and report all employer interactions, job orders, and placements in compliance with Workforce1 and SBS guidelines.
* Analyze data and labor market information to inform outreach strategies and identify new business opportunities.


Qualifications
  
* Business sales, relationship building or a related field preferred (or equivalent relevant experience).
* Minimum 3 years of experience in business development, sales, employer engagement, or workforce development.
* Strong understanding of labor market dynamics, employer needs, and NYC’s business ecosystem.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship management skills.
* Proven ability to meet goals and deliver results in a performance\-driven environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and CRM systems (Dynamics experience preferred).
* Willingness and ability to travel throughout New York City for employer visits and events.


Work Environment
  
This position operates in a fast\-paced, goal\-oriented environment requiring collaboration across multiple teams. The role supports both the Fordham (Hub) and Hunts Point Workforce1 Career Centers, with frequent travel across all five boroughs for employer meetings, events, and business development activities.

Goodwill NY/NJ and the Workforce1 Career Centers are equal opportunity employers committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, or any other protected status.

* Generous Time off policy to use when you need it
* Health, wellness and financial resources to help you achieve our personal goals
* Robust health benefits including medical, dental, vision, parental leaves and company sponsored life insurance
* Retirement matching programs and contributions

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Flagler Health is building the clinical operating system for modern musculoskeletal care.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.


We’ve recently raised our Series B and are entering our next phase of growth.


As Account Manager, you own a portfolio of Flagler's existing customer accounts and are responsible for growing them. You build trusted relationships with clinic and provider\-group stakeholders, understand their goals, and help them get more value from the platform over time. You partner with Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to find where accounts can expand and to turn those opportunities into larger, longer\-term partnerships. Success in the role is measured by account growth and retention.  

What You'll Do

* Own a portfolio of existing accounts and carry a target for growth and retention.
* Build strong relationships with the decision\-makers and day\-to\-day users at each clinic or provider group.
* Learn each account's goals and workflows, and proactively surface ways they can get more value from the platform.
* Identify and close expansion opportunities within your accounts, from first conversation through signed agreement.
* Prepare proposals, pricing, and business cases that show the value of expanding.
* Lead regular account reviews and renewals, and keep customers engaged in between.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to remove blockers and deliver on what you sell.
* Track account health and forecast growth accurately in the CRM.


Required Qualifications

* 5 to 7 years in account management, sales, or a customer\-facing revenue role, with a record of growing existing accounts.
* A consistent track record of hitting growth or retention targets.
* Strong relationship\-building, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Comfort with CRM and sales tooling, pipeline management, and data\-driven account planning.
* Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and priorities at once without losing the details.


Preferred Qualifications

* Healthtech and enterprise experience, highly preferred.
* Experience growing existing customer accounts or expanding product adoption.
* Familiarity with revenue operations tooling and analytics.

**Our Values:**
---------------


This is what you can expect of your teammates at Flagler:

* **Owner:** We own our work like founders. We don't wait to be asked, and we pick up the problem nobody else has.
* **Builder:** We like making things from scratch. We don't need a playbook to start, and we'd rather ship a rough first version than wait on a perfect spec.
* **Fast:** We make quick decisions. We favor progress and respect process.
* **Transparent:** We communicate directly. We value merit and honesty, and we challenge assumptions, including our own.
* **Curious:** We explore new approaches and ask "why" often.


Compensation Range: $85K \- $120K

* Proven record with upselling and meeting or exceeding quota

* Very strong analytical skills to collect business intelligence by monitoring/identifying trends with data, including revenue projections and forecasting

* Basic familiarity with front\-end web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

### **Bonus points if you have:**


* Fluency in French

### **How you'll make an impact:**



As an Associate Publisher Account Manager, you'll bring value by:


* Managing and growing relationships with publisher clients
* Understanding client KPIs and identify upsell opportunities
* Monitoring and analyzing metrics and proactively take steps to improve performance
* Strategic planning and forecasting in alignment with revenue objectives
* Working closely with the Sales \& Product teams in order to become a valuable resource both internally and externally
* Actively participating with peers in a team\-oriented culture and assist other internal groups
* Being the expert on revenue optimization for your book of business and become a trusted advisor for clients based on knowledge of the the industry

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they'll tell you that they've been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They'll also share more about:

**Ready to realize your potential?**



Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.\-



Learn more about \#TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, \& the Taboola Life Blog.

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Since launching in 2006, we adapt and deliver integrated communications, marketing, search, and creative programs that establish long\-term competitive advantage for pioneering tech brands.
