We are looking for a stellar **Account Manager** to join our New York office. Interested? Read on to find out more information about the role and the fantastic benefits available to take advantage of here at Clarity!

  

Our role is a fantastic opportunity for hands\-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to a variety of projects. You'll get to develop your skills and advance your career in a supportive, hybrid work environment. Join us at Clarity, and become part of a team dedicated to driving growth, enhancing reputations, and making a meaningful impact!

 **What you’ll do:**


* Act as point of contact and relationship manager between our clients and our team, building strong client relationships all while gaining a deep understanding of their business and communications needs
* Write and execute communications plans and oversee the strategic direction for key client accounts
* Work closely with the senior team to identify growth opportunities to help our clients achieve their goals, supporting expansion of new service offerings
* Take part in supporting new business pitches/proposals and prepare briefs, proposals and decks for existing clients
* Manage the onboarding and kick off processes for key new accounts and projects
* Proactively identify and look to solve potential issues or blockers and act as an escalation point for client concerns or troubleshooting

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) \- Local is a hard services\-led, tailored facility management solution. We self\-perform hard services while partnering with best\-in\-class soft service providers to offer custom facility and project management solutions to our clients. We focus on empowering our team with a high\-level of downstream accountability resulting in an agile and efficient service delivery.
In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best\-in\-Class services including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience. **About the Role:**
As a CBRE Account Manager , you will oversee a small to medium\-sized team responsible for delivering all client commitments.


This is part of the Operations Management job function. They are responsible for coordinating staff functions and operations that support the organization’s goals and strategies.

**What You’ll Do:*** Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
* Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross\-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
* Consult with sales professionals to define basic project requirements. Investigate various approaches to attain end results. Inform the organization of potential risks and implement action plans to address them.
* Assist with the coordination of resources needed to service projects and build strategic operational plans.
* Responsible for the management of sales, and relationships with small to medium\-sized clients. Identify new sales opportunities and improvements within existing accounts.
* Monitor service level performance to ensure client service levels are met and exceeded. Present findings to Sr. Management.
* Prioritize open issues and tasks, working closely with both internal and client cross\-functional teams. Serve as a point of contact for key systems and processes for projects.
* Manage expectations of the client and project team regarding the scope of work and responsibilities. daily performance and ongoing delivery against contractual obligations
* Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement.
* Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day\-to\-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.

**What You’ll Need:*** Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
* Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to motivate team impact on quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the job discipline and department.
* In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset.

**Why CBRE**
When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants. **Applicant AI Use Disclosure**
We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.  



  

New York Residents: CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience.
The minimum salary for the Account Manager position is $100,400 annually and the maximum salary for the Account Manager position is $165,000 annually.
The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.
Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  

  

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at \+1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and \+1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

In addition to our core facility and project management capabilities, our platform offers direct access to our Best\-in\-Class services, including ESG, Security Consulting, Workplace Strategy, and Workplace Experience. **About the Role:**
As an Account Manager you would be accountable for providing leadership, management, and development of a client account, ensuring both financial and operational commitments are met and exceeded.

* Work with other operational leaders to ensure the collaborative development of the business, effective teamworking, and a culture in keeping with the company’s RISE values.
* Support effective business communication internally and externally, with clients, CBRE team members, vendor partners, tenants, landlords, and all other business stakeholders.
* Support the sales process through solution development, participating in presentations and consultation meetings, and hosting visits as necessary.
* Support account diversity, equity \& inclusion (DE\&I) objectives; promote and maintain CBRE culture throughout account.

* Ensure optimum staffing structures operate across the account, balancing cost reduction with the delivery of service excellence. Ensure structures support peaks and troughs in workload, disaster recovery, and contractual commitments.
* Ensure training needs are delivered, employees are fully competent to undertake their roles, and can reach their full future potential.
* Ensure effective succession planning is completed account\-wide.
  

Finance/Commercial:* Full responsibility for Profit \& Loss including development of account financial plans for revenue and profit delivery, management of WIP, debt, cost control, and growth, ensuring that targets are met or exceeded.
* Ensure business policies and processes are effectively communicated and implemented across the account.
* Drive effective commercial and financial governance through accurate reporting, and appropriate checks and balances.
* Review purchase orders to ensure financial, contractual, and commercial accuracies.
* Supply chain management, including supplier performance reviews, supplier negotiations and re\-bidding, and the identification of additional scope opportunities.
* Drive sustainable organic growth of the account, maximizing extra works and project opportunities.
  

QHSE**:*** Ensure the provision of a healthy and safe working environment on the account.
* Maintain both client and CBRE health and safety policy and process, ensuring this is effectively implemented across all service lines, self\-perform and vendor delivered.
* Develop environmental health and safety procedures for facilities. These procedures include emergency action plans, disaster recovery, business continuity, and other related procedures.
* Responsible for facility inspections for quality assurance on a periodic basis. Ensure facility procedures comply with local, state, and federal regulations.

jobs.title: Marketing Associate | NYC
jobs.description:
**About Blank Street:**



At Blank Street, we're on a mission to become the defining food and beverage brand of our generation. From the very beginning, we've set out to add a spark to ordinary experiences through elevated products, attention\-to\-detail, and a commitment to making every moment memorable. We're motivated by the millions of customers we serve across cities, and know that our potential is unlimited. It all starts with our people and their commitment to make magic happen each and every day.


**Add A Spark to the Ordinary…**

We're hiring a Marketing Associate to help coordinate our biggest brand moments, from seasonal campaigns to new store openings, with the autonomy to run key pieces of these projects. We're not here to just sell matcha, we're here to play a real role in culture. That means big ideas, genuine ownership, and the creative courage to make things that have never been done before. If you've ever thought 'that would never get approved' \- this is the place where it does. Oh, and we have a lot of fun doing it.



Reporting to the US Marketing Manager, this role is 4 days in\-person and based out of our Brooklyn, NY office.


**Who We're Looking For**


* **Experience:** 2\+ years of experience, ideally with some exposure to marketing, brand, or content work. Interest in lifestyle brands or startups is a plus, not a requirement.
* **Eye for Storytelling:** You have a natural instinct for what makes something compelling. You have a strong sense of taste and curiosity about how to tell a story well, even if you're still developing the craft.
* **Eager and Detail\-Oriented:** You're excited to roll up your sleeves and learn by doing. You're organized, follow through on the details, and bring energy to scrappy, fast\-moving work.
* **Plugged Into Culture:** You're online and offline in the ways that matter. You notice trends and moments as they happen and have opinions about what's interesting.


**What You'll Own**


* **Own It, Start to Finish:** You'll run point on some of our store openings across planning, execution, and reporting, beginning to end. You'll partner with our creative, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure we are prepared for opening day and develop the launch plan to make every store a success.
* **Build the Influencer Program:** You'll own our influencer and social tracking work stream across every marketing initiative we run, think new markets, seasonal campaigns, partnerships, brand moments. From who we work with to how we measure it, this one's yours.
* **Be the Glue on Bigger Moments:** From brand partnerships to seasonal launches, you'll coordinate the pieces that make these moments land. You'll support execution across retail, experiential, digital, social, and press, building a feel for how each channel works and how they fit together.
* **Show Up Where It Counts:** You'll be on the ground for openings and events, not just planning from behind a screen, but representing the brand in person, with the trust to make judgment calls without someone hovering.


**Benefits \& Perks**


* $75,000 \- $85,000 annual salary
* + Blank Street, in good faith, believes that the posted salary range is accurate for this role in New York City at the time of posting. Our salary ranges are rooted in the desire to pay competitively relative to our organization size and industry, reflecting just one part of the total compensation package. Blank Street may pay more or less than the posted range based on factors such as relevant experience and skills, qualifications and location, among others. This range may be modified in the future.
* 15 days of paid annual leave (on top of company\-observed holidays and sick time)
* Three health plan options, with full coverage available for two employee\-only tiers
* Commuter benefits
* Parental leave
* Bereavement leave
* Exclusive access to our coveted Regulars program – yes, that means free coffee, matcha and more! ️
* Regular social outings with the team
* Free Blank Street swag

jobs.title: Social Media Manager, New York
jobs.description:
**The Role…**



We're looking for a creative, culturally connected Social Media \& Community Manager based in New York to join our Global Social team.



This is a hands\-on role for someone who lives and breathes social media, thrives in fast\-paced environments, and enjoys creating content as much as planning strategy. You'll play an important role in supporting Soho House's global social channels, while leading a private Instagram account for members in New York.



You'll own the end\-to\-end management of the New York channel \- from content creation and copywriting to community management, reporting and content planning \- working closely with teams across New York and internationally.



This channel is a hyper\-local social channel designed to bring our Houses, community and culture to life through real\-time, insider content. You'll be responsible for shaping its voice, growing engagement and creating content that members genuinely want to follow.



Reporting to the Global Head of Social, you'll work closely with Membership, Operations, Events and Marketing teams, while collaborating with the wider Global Social team to develop ideas, manage content calendars and deliver best\-in\-class social content across Soho House.


**Objectives**


* Build awareness of the current Soho House NY offering, including events, programming, new menus, openings, collaborations and member updates
* Create demand through exclusive access, sneak peeks and 'if you know, you know' moments
* Drive footfall into Houses by encouraging members to engage more frequently with spaces, events and experiences through a considered and creative content calendar
* Strengthen member connection, pride and retention by celebrating the NY community


**Key Responsibilities**


* Own the day\-to\-day management of the NY members\-only Instagram account
* Capture and create social\-first content across Houses, events, screenings, launches and cultural moments
* Contribute creative ideas for global campaigns, content series and always\-on social storytelling
* Produce engaging Reels, Stories and feed content
* Write copy that feels conversational, culturally relevant and distinctly local across social channels
* Build strong relationships with Membership, Events and Operations teams to source content, identify social opportunities and stay ahead of programming
* Manage community engagement, including DMs and comments


**Who We're Looking For**


* A proactive social media manager and content creator with excellent creative instincts
* Strong understanding of Instagram, content creation and community building
* Confident capturing and editing content on mobile
* Excellent copywriting skills with a natural, engaging tone of voice
* Comfortable managing online communities and interpreting social performance data
* Highly organised, self\-motivated and energetic \- able to balance strategy with execution


Important to Know


* This is a full\-time, in\-person role based in New York
* Evening or weekend event attendance will be required
* The successful candidate will spend significant time within Soho Houses and at member events creating content


**Why work with us...**



Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you're seeking entry\-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.


* **Health Care \+ 401K:** Full time employees are eligible for full benefits; Medical, Dental \& Vision as well as Retirement fund with a 2% match

This role goes beyond simply finding influencers or sending outreach messages. The selected candidate will help manage the full influencer marketing process—from creator research and outreach to product gifting, content deadlines, follow\-ups, performance tracking, and recommendations for future campaigns.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, follows through without constant reminders, pays close attention to deadlines, and can identify opportunities to improve campaign results.

* Suggest new influencer categories, outreach approaches, and campaign ideas to improve results
* Work closely with the marketing team while independently managing assigned campaigns

**Qualifications**

* Strong interest in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, fashion, fitness, wellness, or social media
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple creators, deadlines, and campaign details simultaneously
* Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of assigned projects
* Strong written communication skills in English
* Professional and persistent when following up with creators
* Excellent attention to detail
* Able to recognize high\-quality content and strong brand alignment
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, Google Drive, and social media platforms
* Able to provide clear updates without needing frequent reminders
* Reliable, responsive, and deadline\-oriented

Previous experience with influencer outreach, social media marketing, public relations, creator partnerships, affiliate marketing, or campaign coordination is preferred but not required.

Experience with Instagram, TikTok, Shopify Collabs, TikTok Shop, or influencer management platforms is a plus.

* Communicate professionally with creators

* Recommend practical ways to improve future influencer campaigns
* Complete assigned work without waiting for step\-by\-step instructions

* Weekly schedule to be discussed
* Some in\-person availability in New York City may be required
* Additional work may be completed remotely as assigned

* Your résumé
* A brief introduction explaining your interest in influencer marketing
* Any relevant experience with creator outreach, social media, campaign management, fashion, fitness, wellness, or digital marketing

Pay: $17\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Our next opportunity in the U.S. is to make HungryPanda known and used by a wider audience. We are looking for a marketing leader who can see the bigger picture, build a plan for growth, and work hands\-on with the team to make it happen.

**What You Bring / 任职要求**

If you enjoy building a growth strategy and getting close to the work that brings it to life, we’d love to hear from you.

如果你既喜欢制定增长方向，也愿意深入一线推动执行，欢迎加入我们，一起让更多美国消费者认识并选择 HungryPanda！

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Reuters Imagen
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

  

As a **Sales Development Representative** at **Reuters Imagen** , you own the top of the commercial funnel for your territory. You'll find the right prospects, open the right conversations, and qualify opportunities to the point where a commercial specialist can take them forward. The **Reuters Imagen** customer base is a specific world \- sports federations, broadcasters, media rights holders, and enterprise content organisations \- and you'll need to understand it well enough to hold a credible conversation before the CS or AM is in the room.  



  

You'll work in a defined territory and will work closely with both Commercial Specialists and Account Managers at the point of qualification, remaining connected through the sales cycle to inform your own future prospecting.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

As a Sales Development Representative at Reuters Imagen, you will:  



  

* Identify and research target accounts within your territory using a combination of industry knowledge, event intelligence, CRM data, and market signals
* Build and maintain a healthy outbound pipeline through multi\-channel prospecting: personalised outreach, LinkedIn, industry events, and inbound lead follow\-up
* Develop territory plans that prioritise target segments, accounts, and buying triggers relevant to the Imagen platform and Reuters AI ecosystem
* Track and manage prospecting activity and pipeline status accurately in Salesforce
* Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand prospect workflow, content challenges, technology stack, and decision\-making structure
* Articulate the Imagen value proposition clearly and credibly to a range of buyer personas, from operational and technical contacts to commercial and executive stakeholders
* Handle early\-stage objections and questions, and know when to bring in a Solutions Architect or Account Manager
* Execute a clean, well\-briefed handoff to the Commercial Specialist at the point of qualification, with full context on the prospect, the conversation, and the identified opportunity
* Collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and the Commercial Lead to align outreach with live campaigns, product launches, and event follow\-up
* Maintain working knowledge of the sports, media, and broadcast technology landscape in your territory, including rights cycles, federation calendars, platform procurement patterns, and competitive dynamics
* Feed market intelligence back into the commercial team: emerging accounts, competitive moves, buyer sentiment, and territory trends
Represent Reuters Imagen at industry events where attendance supports pipeline development  
* 

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Experience in a sales development, business development, or outbound sales role
* Strong discovery and qualification skills: able to identify genuine opportunity, map decision\-making structure, and brief a handoff accurately
* Demonstrable ability to build pipeline through outbound prospecting and convert cold or warm outreach into qualified conversations
* Comfortable engaging buyer personas from operations and IT through to commercial and executive level
* Fluent professional English, written and verbal; additional language relevant to territory an advantage
* Able to work independently in a remote environment and flex schedule to collaborate across time zones
Demonstrable use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and similar) for research, outreach personalisation, and workflow efficiency  
* 

  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Direct experience selling technology or software solutions; prospecting into sports federations, leagues, broadcasters, or media rights organisations
* Working knowledge of the sports, media, or broadcast industry: understands how rights holders, federations, broadcasters, and content organisations operate, and what their content challenges look like
* Familiarity with media asset management, content distribution, video workflow, or adjacent technology categories
* Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, intent data tools, or similar prospecting platforms an proficiency with Salesforce for pipeline tracking and activity management
Exposure to enterprise SaaS sales cycles including multi\-stakeholder deals and longer procurement timelines

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a driven and relationship\-focused Outside Sales Representative to support growth across a multi\-state territory. This role is responsible for developing new business opportunities, expanding existing customer relationships, and serving as a trusted resource for customers in industries that rely on critical power and electrical infrastructure solutions.  

The ideal candidate will combine strong sales skills with technical aptitude, helping customers identify solutions that support their operational needs while driving revenue growth throughout the assigned territory.  

**Key Responsibilities****Sales \& Customer Relationship Management (60%)*** Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while identifying and securing new business opportunities.
* Promote and sell a broad portfolio of power, electrical, energy storage, charging, and service solutions.
* Conduct customer meetings, product demonstrations, technical presentations, training sessions, and educational events.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, and solution recommendations tailored to customer requirements.
* Review project specifications and technical requirements to develop effective solutions.
* Collaborate with customers and project stakeholders to support specification development and project planning.
* Deliver a high level of customer service and account support throughout the sales cycle.
* Manage customer\-related agreements and business documentation as needed.
* Participate in site visits and field activities to strengthen customer relationships and gain project insight.

**Account Support \& Cross\-Functional Coordination (20%)*** Serve as a liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure expectations are met.
* Coordinate with operations, service, customer support, and leadership teams regarding project updates, delivery schedules, warranty matters, and customer concerns.
* Communicate critical customer requirements to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

**Business Development (10%)*** Develop and execute territory growth strategies.
* Research market trends, industry developments, and competitive activity.
* Generate new leads and identify opportunities within existing and emerging markets.
* Build relationships with key decision\-makers across target industries.

**Industry Engagement \& Marketing Support (5%)*** Represent the organization at trade shows, conferences, networking events, and industry associations.
* Support marketing initiatives by providing market intelligence and customer feedback.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, and evolving customer needs.

**Additional Responsibilities (5%)*** Maintain accurate records, sales activity updates, expense reporting, and scheduling.
* Participate in ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications*** Minimum 5 years of business\-to\-business (B2B) sales experience.
* Experience selling into power systems, electrical infrastructure, utilities, telecommunications, industrial, energy, or related markets preferred.
* Strong understanding of electrical systems, power equipment, energy storage technologies, or related technical products.
* Familiarity with industry standards and regulations is a plus.
* Proven ability to develop and execute territory growth plans.
* Strong presentation, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Self\-starter with the ability to work independently and manage a large territory.
* Proficient with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and other business software tools.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the assigned region.

**Territory Coverage**
This position supports customers throughout:* Coverage areas: Maine, Vermont, New Hampshire, New York, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Delaware, New Jersey, Maryland, West Virginia, and Virginia.

  

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated sales professional who enjoys building relationships, solving customer challenges, and driving growth in a technical, solutions\-based sales environment.  

Pay: $80,000\-$160,000  

\#MCTA1

jobs.description:
Part\-Time Financial Services Sales Representative

Please email us at Hiring@PathwayCatalyst.com for more information about the position, how to get bonuses, raises, more hours, and promotions. The entire roadmap is already established of how we can bring the right candidate from day to an executive after 18 months.

**Pathway Catalyst \| Midtown Manhattan \| In Person Only**  
**10 Positions Available \| $20/Hour \+ Performance Bonuses**  
**No Experience Required \| Paid Training \| Path to Full Time**

**(Experience and/or Bi\-lingual Spanish \-priority)**

Your talent deserves somewhere to grow.

You can start a conversation. You connect with people. You’re ambitious, eager to learn, and ready for an opportunity where your results can increase your income.

**At Pathway Catalyst, we’re hiring people we can train, develop, and grow into our next generation of Account Executives.**

Start part time with a schedule that can work around your current commitments. Learn the business, build your confidence, and see whether financial services sales is the long\-term career you’ve been looking for.

Start with flexibility. Advance with clear targets.

You’ll begin with **20 calling hours per week, plus two additional paid training hours**. Five\-hour morning, afternoon, evening, and weekend shifts offer scheduling options while you get started.

As your verified production grows, you unlock additional hours and higher pay through clearly defined milestones. You’ll know what you’re working toward and how your results move you forward.

**This is a part\-time starting position. Full\-time hours must be earned through performance.** We want to help you qualify as soon as possible. Expanded schedules include morning, night, and weekend coverage requirements.

Build your earning potential.

* **Start at $20/hour**, with performance milestones leading to $21, $22, and up to $25/hour.
* **Unlock more calling hours**, progressing from 20 toward full\-time schedules and potentially up to 60 hours weekly.
* **Earn $2–$5 per verified qualified lead** when you meet the weekly production pace.
* **Earn $5 per verified completed application.**
* **Receive additional fixed funding bonuses** when eligible opportunities you originate result in funding.

Your raise and additional\-hour milestones are separate—you can earn one before the other. Advancement is based on objective, verified results.

**Illustrative first\-year earnings range from approximately $51,000 to nearly $90,000** for employees who maintain the modeled production levels and work their earned additional hours. These projections include hourly pay, paid training, overtime, and lead and application bonuses. They are not guaranteed earnings or the income for remaining at the starting part\-time schedule.

The development roadmap targets advancement toward the next company tier around **12–18 months**, based on performance and readiness, with increased base pay and stronger incentives.

What you’ll do

You’ll work from our Midtown Manhattan office, speaking with business owners by phone and helping them take the first step toward exploring business financing.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Making outbound calls using our dialer and approved scripts.
* Generating interest in business financing and financial services.
* Asking qualification questions and identifying interested prospects.
* Recording accurate information and follow\-up activity in our CRM.
* Helping prospects move toward a completed application.
* Handing qualified opportunities to our account team.
* Participating in training, applying feedback, and tracking your progress.

**You don’t need to arrive as a financial expert.** We’ll teach you our services, systems, qualification process, and approach to productive sales conversations.

Who will thrive here?

Someone who brings energy to the phone, takes coaching seriously, and wants to improve.

We’re looking for:

* Strong communication skills and a willingness to start conversations.
* Reliability, focus, and consistent effort.
* Resilience when a prospect says no.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn.
* Motivation to work toward measurable goals.
* Ambition to earn greater responsibility and income.

Previous sales, customer service, hospitality, or phone experience can help, but **experience is not required**.

This is a high\-energy, in\-person workplace. Personal cell phones must be stored securely while working in the office, and employees are expected to follow that policy without repeated reminders.

We’re hiring for potential—and investing in progress.

You bring the drive. We provide training, coaching, and a defined path forward.

If you have skills you’re ready to develop and want an opportunity to start part time while building toward a bigger career, we’d like to meet you.

**Apply now with your résumé and availability. Tell us what strength you’re ready to put to work.**

**10 positions available. Join Pathway Catalyst and start building your next chapter.**

Pay: $51,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to Commute:

* New York, NY 10018 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
NJ/NY Gotham FC (“Gotham FC” or “the Club”) is a National Women’s Soccer League (“NWSL”) team representing New Jersey and New York. The team plays at Sports Illustrated Stadium in Harrison, NJ. At Gotham FC, we don’t just play soccer; we set trends, challenge the status quo, and lead with bold creativity. While our roots are grounded in the tradition of the beautiful game, everything else about us is fiercely original. We’re here to redefine expectations, break boundaries, and build something that hasn’t been done before. If you’re ready to push the limits and make an impact, you belong at Gotham FC. **The Role:**
Gotham FC is seeking an Inside Sales Representative (ISR) that will report to the Director of Sales. This role is designed for those passionate about sports and eager to develop their sales skills in a fast\-paced, competitive environment. Our ISRs reach their goals by phone prospecting, setting outside appointments, participating in sales/promotional events and prospecting at Gotham FC home matches as well as events. They are also responsible for delivering exceptional customer service, updating and maintaining account records, and other duties as assigned. This position will have set start and end dates. **Key Responsibilities:*** Sales Goals Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed established sales targets for season memberships (full season), group ticket packages, and other offerings.
* Outbound Sales Efforts: Actively engage in outbound sales efforts, including but not limited to prospecting, networking, and cold calling, to generate new business opportunities and build a robust client base.
* Lead Generation and Database Management: Use sales and service best practices to effectively manage lead generation, data capture, and database management to maximize sales potential.
* Customer Service Excellence: Provide exceptional service to all Season Members, group buyers, single\-game buyers, and new business prospects to ensure long\-term satisfaction and retention.
* Sales Strategy Development: Continuously develop and implement creative sales strategies and promotional ideas to generate new business and drive ticket sales.
* Collaboration and Team Culture: Work collaboratively with the sales team, fostering a supportive and motivated environment. Participate in regular sales meetings and training sessions.

 **Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
* Strong Work Ethic \& Competitiveness: A self\-starter with a positive attitude and a passion for achieving sales goals.
* Team Player: Ability to collaborate and work well within a team environment.
* Outbound Sales Comfort: Comfortable with making outbound cold calls.
* Career\-Oriented: A strong desire to start a career with a team offering significant growth opportunities.
* Professional Presentation: Demonstrates professionalism in both appearance and interactions with individuals at all organizational levels.
* Adaptability: Able to address challenges and adapt quickly in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

Proven Results\-Driven Approach: Demonstrated success in achieving or exceeding sales targets and driving results.  
* 

**Capability \& Other Characteristics:*** Legally authorized to work in the United States.

 **Location:**
Based at Gotham FC’s business office, which is located at 15 Exchange Place, Jersey City, New Jersey, on a hybrid working schedule that consists of three core in\-office/in\-person days (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) and two non\-core days (Monday and Friday), with the option of being in the business office or remote. Ability to attend all home games and any mandatory events as well as away games, as necessary. A willingness to travel for other business\-related needs, as they arise. Ability to work at the team’s soccer operations office in Whippany, New Jersey, as needed. Gotham FC requires its associates to live in its market, that is, within reasonable commuting distance of Gotham FC’s offices, practice facility and Sports Illustrated Arena.  

Gotham FC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes everyone to our team. We are committed to broadening the pool of qualified talent for consideration, including those who have been historically underrepresented. We strongly encourage people of color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non\-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities to apply. **Job type:** Full\-time Non\-Exempt position  

**Salary range:** $20 Per Hour \+ Commission opportunities  

**Benefits**: Medical, Dental \& Vision benefit plans available for Employee and Family, Employee\-funded 401(k) option  


This job description is a broad summary of the essential job functions and general duties for this position, the additional job duties that may be required from time\-to\-time, the level of knowledge and skill typically required, and the scope of responsibility, but should not be considered an all\-inclusive listing of work requirements. The person in this role may be required to and must be willing to perform other duties as assigned to meet organizational needs. This job description may be modified from time to time, at the sole discretion of Gotham FC.  


This employee must follow and enforce all policies and procedures formulated by Gotham FC and be a role model for the organization.  


The existence of this job description does not modify the employee’s “at\-will” status. That is, unless a signed employment contract specifying a term of employment exists between Gotham FC and the employee or his/her/their representative, both Gotham FC and the employee will have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without reason or notice, unless otherwise prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

You'll start the conversations that become Ande's enterprise deals. You'll research companies that spend on corporate entertainment, open conversations with the people who book and approve that spend, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.


This is an in\-office role on a small, early sales team. You'll work day to day with the Enterprise GTM Lead and the AEs you support, and help shape the outbound playbook as we grow.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect into enterprise accounts that fit Ande's ideal customer profile.
* Run outbound across email, phone and LinkedIn to the people who book and approve entertainment spend
* Use AI native tools to research every account before you reach out, so each message is specific to the person and their business.
* Book qualified meetings: an account that fits our profile, a conversation with a decision maker or key influencer, and an opportunity the AE moves to the qualified stage.
* Hand each meeting to the AE with clear context, and keep your activity and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.
* Work conferences and events with the team, and follow up on the contacts made there.
* Share what you hear from prospects, including which messages land and which don't, so we can sharpen targeting and messaging.
* Hit a quarterly qualified\-meeting target.

**What We're Looking For**

* Prospect into enterprise accounts that fit Ande's ideal customer profile.
* Run outbound across email, phone and LinkedIn to the people who book and approve entertainment spend
* Use AI native tools to research every account before you reach out, so each message is specific to the person and their business.
* Book qualified meetings: an account that fits our profile, a conversation with a decision maker or key influencer, and an opportunity the AE moves to the qualified stage.
* Hand each meeting to the AE with clear context, and keep your activity and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.
* Work conferences and events with the team, and follow up on the contacts made there.
* Share what you hear from prospects, including which messages land and which don't, so we can sharpen targeting and messaging.
* Hit a quarterly qualified\-meeting target.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience prospecting into procurement, events or field marketing teams.
* Familiarity with events, or travel and expense software.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools in your prospecting workflow.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

*Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status*


Compensation Range: $80K

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


Join Syneos Health in partnership with a large Biopharmaceutical company as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative (PSR). Become a part of a fast\-paced and challenging environment where our compassion and dedication drive us to meet the unique needs and goals of our customers. The PSR role is responsible for building relationships with recognized experts, healthcare providers (HCPs) and prioritized stakeholders.

**The successful PSR will:**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key accounts with the goal of maximizing sales
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action
* Deliver clinical brand specific presentations of product(s) to physicians and other appropriate health care professionals
* Develop a complete understanding of the health care delivery system within each assigned customer, including the physician hierarchy, key pharmacy personnel, clinical nursing staff, etc.
* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Leverage AI\-driven insights and digital engagement tools to personalize healthcare provider interactions and improve customer experience.
* Adapt to emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and automation tools, to enhance productivity, customer engagement, and business outcomes.

As a Sales Development Representative, you'll report to our SDR Manager and build a qualified pipeline for our Enterprise and Strategic sales teams. Most of your day is outbound: researching accounts, picking up the phone, and opening conversations with product leaders who haven't met Fullstory yet. AI is part of how you'll work every day, taking the busywork out of research so more of your time goes to real conversations.

**In a typical day, you might:**

* Book six qualified opportunities a month, mostly through outbound. Inbound leads help, but they won't get you to quota on their own.
* Prospect into a shared pool of enterprise and strategic accounts
* Cold call the buyers we win with most, and think on your feet when they push back.
* Research accounts and prospects in Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, and pull them into Outreach, so every call opens with a reason the person on the other end should care.
* Use AI tools to research accounts, prep calls, and cut repetitive steps from your day, so you ramp faster and spend more time selling.
* Spend your in\-office day in Atlanta alongside our sales leaders, getting close to the work.

**Here’s what we’re looking for:**

* You've sold something where the results were yours: door\-to\-door, phone sales, retail, events, or an SDR internship.
* You've done high\-volume cold outreach, by phone or in person, to people who weren't expecting you.
* You've worked against a number, like dials, sales, or a quota, and can show how you tracked against it.
* You've worked somewhere that changed fast, like new targets, processes, or team structure, and adapted without waiting for direction.
* You've used an AI tool like Claude to build something or cut real time out of a workflow.

***The impact you will have in 6 months:***

* You're consistently hitting target by booking qualified meetings each month, mostly from outbound you sourced, and running your own week without daily direction.
* AI is a natural part of how you work, and you're always looking for new ways it can help you prospect smarter.

***The impact you will have in 12 months:***

* You're someone other reps learn from: sharing messaging that works, leading a call review, or helping other reps streamline their workflows.
* You've opened doors at tough accounts through months of persistent outbound, building a track record of beating your number.


The base salary for this position ranges from $50,000 \- $55,000 USD. Including the base salary, this role has an OTE (on\-target earnings) of $76,923 \- $84,615 USD. Total compensation will vary based on relevant experience, qualifications, and market conditions.


\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-BS1

### **About Fullstory**


Fullstory is a leading behavioral data platform transforming how businesses understand and improve their digital experiences. Our technology empowers companies to uncover insights, optimize customer and employee journeys, and deliver exceptional online interactions. It makes every customer experience smoother and more personalized and empowers the employees behind the scenes.


We’re building something special at Fullstory\- and we’re looking for teammates who are curious, collaborative, and driven to make an impact. We’re especially excited about the potential of AI to enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and elevate our work. If that resonates, explore our Winning Ways to see the values that guide how we work and grow together.

**How we support you:**


Fullstorians are committed to building something better\- from how we approach our product, to how we care for our customers and each other. Along these lines, we offer:

* **Flexibility and Connection.** We have a vibrant HQ in Atlanta and a tight\-knit group in London. Fullstorians in those cities come to the office at least one day a week to build cross\-functional relationships and stay connected. We also offer a flexible PTO policy and an annual company\-wide closure, along with federal holidays.
* **Benefits.** Take care of the whole you. Fullstory offers sponsored benefit packages for US\-based Fullstorians, and supplemental coverage options for international Fullstorians.
* **Learning opportunities.** We provide professional development opportunities through training programs and an annual learning subsidy for US and EMEA\-based employees.
* **Productivity support.** US and EMEA\-based Fullstorians receive a monthly productivity stipend.
* **Team Collaboration.** Connect with fellow Fullstorians through team off\-sites and an annual full\-company meet\-up.
* **Paid parental leave.** Fullstorians balance the needs of their growing families without the added stress of figuring out work and finances.
* **Bereavement leave, including miscarriage/pregnancy loss**. Take the time to grieve and help your loved ones.

*Fullstory is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace dedicated to fostering an increasingly diverse community. We want candidates of all human varieties, backgrounds, and lifestyles. There’s no problem that can’t be made better by bringing together people with a broader set of perspectives.* ***If our product, values, and community resonate with you, please apply– we'd love to hear from you!***

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
Logical Position is an industry\-leading digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow through a full suite of online marketing services. Recognized as one of the nation's top workplaces and marketing agencies, Logical Position has earned awards including Inc.'s Best Places to Work, the BBB Torch Award for Ethics, and multiple performance\-based awards from Google and Microsoft.


As a Business Development Representative, you'll introduce prospective clients to our services by researching businesses, building your own lead pipeline, and engaging business owners through phone and email outreach.


You'll receive a structured five\-week sales training program focused on our services, sales process, and proven approach to helping clients succeed. We're looking for sales professionals with a track record of generating opportunities, building relationships, and achieving results who are ready to continue growing their careers in digital marketing sales.

**Compensation****$60,000 annual base pay \+ uncapped commission**


Our compensation plan rewards both new sales and long\-term client success through:

* 15%\-30% commission on new business
* Up to $450 contract bonus per sale
* 1%\-11% recurring commission on eligible client management fees during the client's first 24 months with Logical Position

**What You’ll Do*** Cold call, email, and prospect businesses to build a qualified pipeline, generate new business opportunities, and drive revenue
* Qualify prospects through consultative discovery to understand their business, marketing challenges, and budgets to ensure sales efforts prioritize opportunities that align with the company’s services and approved industries
* Clearly communicate and sell Logical Position's value proposition, demonstrating how our digital marketing services, expertise, technology, and partnerships can help prospective clients improve performance and grow their business
* Own and consistently achieve individual sales goals, including expectations around new revenue, closed business, qualified pipeline generation, productivity, and other key performance metrics
* Maintain accurate CRM records and timely sales notes to ensure clear follow\-up, reliable pipeline tracking, and an organized, consistent sales process
* Adhere to company sales policies, procedures, and ethical standards by accurately representing services, pricing, and expected outcomes; making only authorized commitments

**What We’re Looking For****Required Qualifications**

* 1\+ years of sales, business development, customer acquisition, or revenue\-generating experience.
* Experience engaging prospective customers through outbound outreach, including phone and email.
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to build relationships, uncover customer needs, and communicate value effectively.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow\-up activities.
* Basic technical aptitude and the ability to learn CRM systems, sales tools, and new technology.
* Coachable mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Strong ethical judgment and integrity.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and general computer skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B2B sales experience.
* Experience selling to business owners or other decision\-makers.
* Track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals.

**Why Logical Position?*** Industry\-leading digital marketing agency with a strong reputation and award\-winning culture
* Structured five\-week sales training program designed to set you up for success
* Uncapped earning potential
* Ongoing coaching and professional development
* Remote work opportunity
* Opportunity to sell services that help businesses grow and succeed

**Benefits*** **Paid Time Off:** You will accrue 14 days in your first year with increases in tenure.
* **Volunteer Time Off:** You accrue 40 hours in your first year.
* **Paid Holidays:** Receive a minimum of 7 paid holidays and 3 floating holidays awarded per anniversary year.
* **Work From Home:** We have two offices—Lake Oswego, OR and Palatine, IL — but employees may choose to work from their home address.
* **Remote Office Space Reimbursement:** Eligible for up to $100 following 30 days of employment to improve your remote office space. LP provides you with a work laptop, headset, mouse, and monitor.
* **Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance:** Eligible following 60 days of employment, and LP will cover up to 75% for the employee premium depending on the plan that you select.
* **401(k) Match:** Eligible following 90 days of employment. LP matches 100% of the first 4% of income contributed.
* **Paid Parental Leave:** Eligible for up to 12 weeks.
* **Paid Bereavement:** Eligible for up to 5 days.
* **Employee Assistance Program:** Access to free and confidential coaching, counseling, work\-life balance, and self\-help resources.
* **Work/Life Balance:** We encourage a healthy work/life balance for all employees.




**AI Use During Hiring:** While LP embraces AI, candidates must complete the hiring process using their own knowledge and experience. The use of generative AI tools or assistance from another person during interviews is not permitted unless expressly authorized by Logical Position.


**Important:** Clicking Continue starts your application. Be sure to complete all required steps, including uploading your resume, before exiting the application.

*The application window will close once a sufficient number of qualified candidates have been identified, which may occur before or after a conditional offer is made.*

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Our Mission**:

**Join the Industry Leader in Lifting Solutions**  

At **Bishop Lifting Products, Inc.**, we don’t just move loads – we move industries forward. As the most trusted name in lifting, we’ve been solving routine and complex challenges since 1984 with top\-quality products, deep expertise, and unmatched customer service. From wire ropes to rigging, slings, and below\-the\-hook solutions, we’ve got the gear and the grit to support America’s toughest jobs.
With **40\+ locations nationwide**, a growing team, and a culture built on safety, service, and teamwork, Bishop Lifting is where hard work meets opportunity. Be part of a company that’s **lifting the industry – and our people – to new heights.****Your next big move starts here.** **Job Purpose:**


The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for generation of new client opportunities and the expansion of existing customer opportunities in the defined target market that meet the product and service sales goals and new client requirements.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

Specific Duties include, but are not limited to:

* Develop, cultivate, and penetrate the defined selling territory and target market prospects, primarily by bringing in orders from new accounts
* The ongoing development and deepening of existing client relationships in the selling territory
* Follow and utilize company’s sales systems and prospect development processes.
* Identify proper prospect buying influences and correctly identify their site challenges, the reasons they are occurring, and solutions for solving their challenges.
* Meet daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly activity and revenue objectives
* Participate in the development of your annual sales development plan with management
* Communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, with all team members to ensure a consistent and effective delivery to the client.
* Build an effective professional network by participating in organizations and events that foster these opportunities and builds referral sources
* Endeavor to grow personally and professionally by participating in industry and sales related seminars, workshops, and organizations
* Ability to complete and present daily and weekly pipeline reports in a timely manner

**Job Requirements:**

* At least two years successful outside sales experience in Rigging/Lifting products highly preferred
* At least three years preferred in Industrial/Equipment sales
* Must understand and utilize consultative selling
* Must be sales and results driven
* Must be able to maintain reports on quotas, prospective customers, and various other data
* Experience working with a CRM and Microsoft Office Suite
* Mechanical background a plus
* Effective problem solving skills and experience with prospects and clients
* A well\-organized and self\-directed individual who is a team player
* An energetic, forward\-thinking, and creative individual with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image
* An intelligent and articulate individual who can relate to people at all levels of an organization across diverse cultures, and possesses excellent communication and presentation skills
* Must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship
* Must be able to pass a pre\-employment background check (including MVR) and drug screening.

**Company Perks for Outside Sales Representatives at Bishop Lifting:** Annual Base Salary \+ **Uncapped commission**, participation in our **CarData** **program**, cell phone reimbursement, PTO accrual, **First Day Benefits**\- including health, dental, and vision. Company\-paid Life Insurance, AD\&D, STD, LTD, 401K with match \& equity credits!

**Bishop Lifting Products, Inc. and it’s subsidiaries are an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.


Are you looking for an opportunity to become part of a rapidly\-growing industry? Bishop Lifting Products, Inc. is looking for talent that will hold true to our mission while maintaining the safety and knowledge that we have valued since we were founded in 1984\.


Apply today! We’re ready to help you start your new career path.

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self\-motivated, results\-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross\-functional discipline is critical. Cross\-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision\-making.
* Demonstrate account\-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3\+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2\+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor\-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top\-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self\-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical \& analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

  

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem\-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Freshpoint’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.


**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Mileage reimbursement and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Freshpoint customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.

* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

* Submit to pre\-employment testing (Drug Screen, Background Check).
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.description:
**Basic Functions:**  

The Inside Sales Representative supports Sabert’s food\-packaging sales organization by developing customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, managing customer inquiries, preparing pricing quotations, and coordinating with internal teams to meet customer needs.



This role is designed for early\-career professionals who are interested in developing a career in sales, account management, and the packaging industry. As part of Sabert’s Early Career Talent Development Program, the Inside Sales Representative receives hands\-on learning and development while supporting new business development, customer account management, sales pipeline activity, and territory\-growth initiatives.



The successful candidate demonstrates strong communication skills, business acumen, customer focus, organization, and a willingness to learn in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Develop and maintain relationships with existing customers through phone, email, and virtual meetings.
* Support Outside Sales Representatives and Key Account Managers in managing customer accounts and responding to customer needs.
* Identify and qualify new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, lead follow\-up, and account\-development activities.
* Prepare pricing quotations, sales proposals, customer presentations, and other sales support materials.
* Process customer inquiries, sample requests, and order\-related questions accurately and in a timely manner.
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to ensure customer expectations are met.
* Monitor customer activity, sales pipeline progress, account opportunities, and follow\-up actions using CRM tools.
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales forecasts, activity reports, and opportunity information.
* Develop a strong understanding of Sabert’s packaging products, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and market applications.
* Analyze customer needs and recommend appropriate products, solutions, or internal resources.
* Assist with resolving customer concerns and escalate issues, as appropriate, to ensure timely resolution.
* Support territory\-growth initiatives and contribute to revenue, account\-development, and sales\-performance targets.
* Participate in customer meetings, trade shows, sales training, and professional\-development opportunities.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

  


**Required Knowledge and Skills:**


* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Customer\-focused approach with the ability to build and maintain productive business relationships.
* Foundational sales acumen and the ability to identify customer needs, assess opportunities, and propose appropriate solutions.
* Strong organizational, planning, and time\-management abilities, with the ability to manage multiple customer requests and priorities.
* Demonstrated initiative, curiosity, problem\-solving ability, and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional manufacturing and commercial environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
* Ability to use CRM systems to track customer activity, sales opportunities, forecasts, and account information.
* Ability to learn and communicate product features, packaging materials, manufacturing capabilities, and market applications.

* Experience: Zero to four years of professional experience in sales, customer service, account management, or a related customer\-facing role.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

Overview


Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high\-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our Strategic Plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work\-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.


About Georgia Tech


Georgia Tech is a top\-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top\-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1\.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.
  

Georgia Tech's Mission and Values

  

Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

  

1\. Students are our top priority.


2\. We strive for excellence.


3\. We thrive on diversity.


4\. We celebrate collaboration.


5\. We champion innovation.


6\. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.


7\. We nurture the wellbeing of our community.


8\. We act ethically.


9\. We are responsible stewards.


Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

Typically supervise administrative staff, to include training, making assignments and monitoring performance.

Track documentation requiring Dean's signature.

Prepare financial related reports and maintain records.
  

  

**Job Duty 7 \-**  

Coordinate human resources related actions.
  

  

**Job Duty 8 \-**  

Coordinate travel schedules and itineraries.

Bachelor's Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Six years of job related experience

Proficient in Microsoft Office 365

These values serve as the foundation for all that we do as an organization, and each USG community member is responsible for demonstrating and upholding these standards.
